Ahri.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle early and choose Mercury's Treads. Ahri deals mostly magic damage, but magic resistance cannot reduce the true damage from Ahri Q Orb of Deception on its return. If Ahri P Essence Theft keeps healing away your poke, fit Morellonomicon in after completing one core item.
Ahri.escape: The moment after dodging Ahri E Charm is your chance to engage. When using Twisted Fate R Destiny to travel, cast it from a spot outside enemy vision so it cannot be interrupted and canceled.
Ahri.combo: If Ahri E Charm is down and you can get within auto-attack range, lock in the yellow card with Twisted Fate W Pick a Card and walk up. When roaming, use Twisted Fate R Destiny to reveal the area, lock in the yellow card, then reactivate to travel. Hit an auto attack and Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards as soon as you land.
Ahri.fight: If Ahri R Spirit Rush is down, stun her with the yellow card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card, then follow with Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards.
Ahri.laning: Stay behind minions to dodge Ahri E Charm, and focus on pushing the wave before looking for kills. Clear the backline with Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards, but angle them beside the wave when targeting Ahri too. Use the time after pushing to roam or establish vision.
Ahri.phase: After learning Twisted Fate R Destiny, push the wave and move to another lane to create a numbers advantage. You remain squishy in the late game, so deal damage from the backline and keep moving as you fight.
Ahri.teamfight: Hold your position at the back and throw Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards. If Ahri dives in and threatens your allies, stop her with the yellow card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card. Look for a chance to attack with your team right after Ahri E Charm is down.
Ahri.watch: Stay behind the minion wave to avoid Ahri E Charm, which can set up all of her follow-up damage. Ahri Q Orb of Deception can hit on its return as well, and its return damage is true damage, so move out of its return path even after dodging the first pass.

Anivia.fight: Avoid direct fights early, and take short trades with the yellow card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card when Anivia Q Flash Frost is down. If Anivia P Rebirth is still available, do not try to break the egg alone; go in with your allies.
Anivia.build: Survive the early game with Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury's Treads. Anivia deals mostly magic damage, so build magic resistance first. If Anivia P Rebirth keeps restoring the health you poke away, fit Morellonomicon in after completing one core item.
Anivia.combo: Lock in the yellow card with Twisted Fate W Pick a Card, then walk into auto-attack range and use a stun auto attack, Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards, and another auto attack.
Anivia.escape: When Anivia Q Flash Frost is down, you have a chance to close the gap while avoiding the stun. Anivia has no mobility, so approach with Twisted Fate R Destiny and hit her with the yellow card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card. R's travel can be canceled by crowd control, so activate it from a spot outside enemy vision.
Anivia.laning: Clear the backline minions with Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards to push first, then roam or establish vision while Anivia catches the wave. If Anivia stands behind minions, throw Q at an angle beside the wave. You can restore mana with the blue card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card and clear the wave with the red card.
Anivia.phase: From midgame, after learning Twisted Fate R Destiny, push the wave and create a numbers advantage in another lane. In the late game, watch out for Anivia's terrain control; as a squishy Twisted Fate, contribute from the backline with damage and movement.
Anivia.teamfight: Anivia W Crystallize can block narrow jungle and river paths, so fight in open lanes and save Flash in case you get separated from your team. Use Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards from the back, and stop enemies who dive onto your allies with the yellow card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card. Even when you have no angle to travel, you can use Twisted Fate R Destiny to reveal the enemy jungler's and mid laner's positions and tell your team.
Anivia.watch: Anivia Q Flash Frost explodes where it is recast and stuns, so do more than dodge slightly to the side: stay outside its range from the start. If you are hit by Q or are inside a fully formed Anivia R Glacial Storm, Anivia E Frostbite deals more damage, so leave the storm immediately. Anivia W Crystallize can block your escape on narrow paths.

Akshan.teamfight: Use Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards from the back, and stop Akshan when he dives onto your allies with the yellow card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card. If you are marked as the scoundrel, do not face Akshan alone and stay outside his execute range. If an ally is targeted by Akshan R Comeuppance, you can stand in front of them to take the shots.
Akshan.build: Akshan deals mostly physical damage, and Twisted Fate has low armor, so build armor first. Survive the early game with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps.
Akshan.combo: If Akshan E Heroic Swing is down, lock in the yellow card with Twisted Fate W Pick a Card and walk into auto-attack range. You must use the locked-in card within 6 seconds, so choose it from within reach.
Akshan.escape: The moment after you make Akshan use E Heroic Swing is your window to engage. If you close the gap with Twisted Fate R Destiny, have the yellow card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card ready to stun him as soon as you land.
Akshan.fight: Close the gap just after you make Akshan use E Heroic Swing, stun him with the yellow card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card, then hit him with Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards.
Akshan.laning: Focus on pushing the wave before looking for kills. Angle Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards to clear the backline, and dodge Akshan Q Avengerang's path when it hits minions and gains range. Use the time after pushing to establish vision or move to another lane.
Akshan.phase: Twisted Fate is weak in direct fights early, so hold out while pushing the wave. You remain squishy in the late game, so contribute damage from the back and keep moving as you fight.
Akshan.watch: Akshan Q Avengerang gains range each time it hits an enemy, so do not assume you are safe behind minions; dodge both its outward and return paths. Akshan E Heroic Swing uses walls to engage, so keep your distance near walls. When Akshan R Comeuppance targets you at low health, move behind terrain instead of fleeing alone through open ground.

Corki.combo: After Corki W Valkyrie is down, reveal vision with Twisted Fate R Destiny from a spot without vision, lock in the gold card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card, then recast Twisted Fate R Destiny to travel. You must use the locked-in card with an auto-attack within 6 seconds.
Corki.build: Early on, survive with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps for your boots. Corki E Gatling Gun and Corki R Missile Barrage deal mostly physical damage, so build armor first. Corki P Hextech Munitions deals true damage that resistances cannot block, so withstand it with your total health.
Corki.escape: The moment after you make Corki use W Valkyrie is your window to engage. Before then, do not force an approach because Corki can escape over terrain. Once you confirm Corki W Valkyrie is down, approach with Twisted Fate R Destiny and land the gold card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card.
Corki.fight: Right after Corki uses Corki W Valkyrie, he has no mobility available, so close the gap with Twisted Fate R Destiny and stun him with the gold card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card. Do not stand in front of Corki E Gatling Gun for long while trading damage.
Corki.laning: Clear the backline with Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards to push the wave first, then roam or secure vision while Corki catches the wave. When dodging Corki R Missile Barrage, move out of range rather than standing behind minions.
Corki.phase: Corki gets stronger as he completes items, so do not give him time to farm comfortably. In the late game, Twisted Fate should fight from the backline because he is fragile.
Corki.teamfight: Twisted Fate throws out Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards from the backline and stops enemies diving onto allies with the gold card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card. Move to the side when facing Corki E Gatling Gun, and reposition to avoid being hit by Corki R Missile Barrage in a row. Twisted Fate R Destiny can also reveal vision without traveling, letting you report the enemy jungler and mid laner's positions.
Corki.watch: Corki R Missile Barrage also damages targets around the first one it hits, so do not hide behind minions; move out of range. In particular, reposition to avoid being hit by the third missile in a row. Corki E Gatling Gun reduces your armor and magic resistance if it reaches you, so do not stand and take it head-on; move to the side.

Draven.laning: Farm safely early and do not give Draven a chance to get a kill. When pushing the wave with Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards, angle them toward the backline, then use your time after pushing to secure vision or move to another lane. If Draven steps forward and leaves the wave pushed, you can look for him with your jungler.
Draven.build: Early on, buy Cloth Armor first to survive. Draven deals mostly physical damage and Twisted Fate has low armor, so build armor first and choose Plated Steelcaps for your boots.
Draven.combo: Watch where Draven's axe will land and prepare the gold card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card.
Draven.escape: Draven has no skill to create distance on his own, so the opportunity to close the gap comes after Draven E Stand Aside is down. Use Twisted Fate R Destiny from outside enemy vision to approach, then catch Draven as he retreats with the gold card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card.
Draven.fight: Avoid trading while Draven has two axes. When he has one or fewer, stun him with the gold card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card so he cannot catch an axe, then attack. Focus on making Draven drop his axes instead of trying to kill him immediately.
Draven.phase: Early on, Twisted Fate has low defenses and Draven's axe autos are strong, so avoid direct fights. Twisted Fate is still fragile in the late game, so deal damage from the backline and keep moving as you fight.
Draven.teamfight: Twisted Fate deals damage with Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards from the backline. Stop enemies diving onto allies with the gold card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card, and use a card against Draven to keep him from reaching the spot where he can catch an axe. If low on health, get out of range and both the outward and return paths of Draven R Whirling Death.
Draven.watch: When Draven maintains two axes from Draven Q Spinning Axe, his auto-attacks deal heavy damage, so avoid trading early. Be careful when engaging so you do not get hit by the forced movement and slow from Draven E Stand Aside. Draven R Whirling Death returns, so even after dodging the first hit, move out of both its outward and return paths.

Ambessa.watch: When you see the shield and windup for Ambessa W Repudiation, stop attacking and walk out of range. If Ambessa E Lacerate hits you, it is hard to dodge the blade tip of the follow-up Ambessa Q Cunning Sweep / Sundering Slam, so do not step forward when you cannot use the yellow card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card. Ambessa R Public Execution cannot be interrupted by crowd control, so do not stand in a straight line with Ambessa and your backline when facing her.
Ambessa.build: Survive the early game with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps. Ambessa deals mostly physical damage, and Twisted Fate has low armor, so build armor first. Ambessa R Public Execution has armor penetration, and Ambessa Q Cunning Sweep / Sundering Slam deals damage based on maximum health, so avoid choices that add a lot of health alone.
Ambessa.combo: Right after Ambessa spends her abilities and charges, lock in the yellow card with Twisted Fate W Pick a Card, walk into auto-attack range, stun her, then follow with Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards and an auto attack. When engaging with Twisted Fate R Destiny, reveal the area and lock in the yellow card before traveling, then land a stun auto attack and Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards as soon as you arrive.
Ambessa.escape: Your window to engage is right after Ambessa spends her abilities and all charges of Ambessa P Drakehound's Step. If you close the gap with Twisted Fate R Destiny then, start traveling from outside enemy vision and have the yellow card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card ready when you land. Do not engage while slowed by Ambessa E Lacerate or while Ambessa W Repudiation is being readied.
Ambessa.fight: When Ambessa can use her abilities, Ambessa P Drakehound's Step can close the gap with a dash, so poke from a distance. Right after Ambessa spends her abilities and charges, stun her with the yellow card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card and deal damage with Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards. Do not attack while Ambessa W Repudiation is being readied.
Ambessa.laning: Throw Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards diagonally beside the wave to poke the backline and Ambessa behind it. Use the time after pushing to establish vision or move to another lane, and do not step in front of Ambessa when you cannot use Twisted Fate W Pick a Card.
Ambessa.phase: Midgame, while core items are building up, is Ambessa's peak. Twisted Fate remains squishy in the late game, so deal damage from the back and keep moving.
Ambessa.teamfight: Use Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards from the very back, and stop Ambessa when she dives onto your allies with the yellow card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card. Ambessa R Public Execution targets the farthest enemy champion in a straight line, so do not stand in line with your backline. Even when you have no angle to travel with Twisted Fate R Destiny, you can use it to reveal Ambessa and the other enemies' positions to your team.

Caitlyn.phase: Caitlyn is strong in lane early and Twisted Fate is weak in direct fights, so focus on not giving up kills. Caitlyn's relative strength fades as the game goes on, but Twisted Fate remains fragile in the late game, so fight from the backline.
Caitlyn.build: Early on, buy Cloth Armor first and choose Plated Steelcaps for your boots. Caitlyn deals mostly physical damage, so build armor first. Also get tenacity and movement speed so Caitlyn does not gain distance from you while you are rooted by a trap.
Caitlyn.escape: Avoid paths where Caitlyn W Yordle Snap Trap has been placed, and activate the teleport portion of Twisted Fate R Destiny from outside enemy vision. After landing, stun with the gold card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card.
Caitlyn.fight: Avoid direct fights early, and look for an opening right after Caitlyn Q Piltover Peacemaker is used to clear the wave.
Caitlyn.laning: Focus on pushing the wave before looking for kills. Angle Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards from beside the wave to clear the backline, then use your time after pushing to secure vision or roam. When Caitlyn's early pressure is strong, do not overextend; farm under your tower.
Caitlyn.teamfight: Deal damage from the backline with Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards, and stop enemies diving onto allies with the gold card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card. Even if you have no angle to move in, use Twisted Fate R Destiny to check the positions of the enemy jungler and mid laner and alert your team. If an ally is targeted by Caitlyn R Ace in the Hole, you can step into the bullet's path and take the hit for them.
Caitlyn.watch: If you step on Caitlyn W Yordle Snap Trap, you are rooted and take heavy damage from Caitlyn P Headshot's increased range. Watch for traps in brush and narrow paths, and change your approach route. When Caitlyn pokes with Caitlyn Q Piltover Peacemaker, stand behind allied minions to take reduced damage.

Akali.build: Survive the early game with Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury's Treads. Akali deals mostly magic damage, and Twisted Fate has low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. Also build enough total health to withstand the second hit of Akali R Perfect Execution, and add penetration against Akali's high magic resistance.
Akali.combo: Lock in the yellow card with Twisted Fate W Pick a Card, then walk into auto-attack range and use a stun auto attack, Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards, and another auto attack. Choose the card from within reach so you can use the yellow card with an auto attack within 6 seconds.
Akali.escape: Dodging the first projectile from Akali E Shuriken Flip removes one of her ways to close the gap. Do not engage just because Akali W Twilight Shroud or Akali E Shuriken Flip is down; look especially for an opening before Akali R Perfect Execution comes back up. Then close the gap with Twisted Fate R Destiny and use the yellow card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card.
Akali.fight: If you dodge the first projectile from Akali E Shuriken Flip, or Akali comes out of Akali W Twilight Shroud to attack, stun her with the yellow card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card and fight back. Do not step forward when you do not have the yellow card.
Akali.laning: Focus on pushing the wave before looking for kills. Clear the backline with Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards, then roam or establish vision while Akali catches the pushed-in wave. If Akali stands behind minions, angle Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards beside the wave.
Akali.phase: After learning Twisted Fate R Destiny, your first power spike comes from pushing the wave and creating a numbers advantage in another lane. You remain squishy in the late game, so contribute damage from the backline and keep moving as you fight.
Akali.teamfight: Hold your position at the back and throw Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards. If Akali dives onto your allies, stop her with the yellow card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card. Focus on stopping enemies who engage rather than going in first to stun someone.
Akali.watch: Prioritize dodging the first projectile from Akali E Shuriken Flip. Once marked, you cannot escape the second dash by running, and you cannot dodge the first dash of Akali R Perfect Execution by walking. You can throw Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards at the spot where Akali is briefly revealed as she enters Akali W Twilight Shroud.

Annie.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads early. Annie deals magic damage, so build magic resistance to withstand her burst.
Annie.combo: When fighting at close range, lock in the yellow card with Twisted Fate W Pick a Card, walk into auto-attack range and stun her, then follow with Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards and an auto attack.
Annie.escape: The moment after Annie P Pyromania's stun is spent is your chance to engage. Annie has no mobility, so close the gap with Twisted Fate R Destiny and catch her with the yellow card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card. Annie E Molten Shield can increase her movement speed, so choose the yellow card before traveling.
Annie.fight: When Annie P Pyromania's stun is down, stun her with the yellow card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card, then deal damage with Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards and an auto attack.
Annie.laning: Focus on pushing the wave before looking for kills. Clear the backline with Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards, then establish vision or move to another lane while Annie catches the pushed-in wave. To hit Annie, angle your cards beside the wave.
Annie.phase: After learning Twisted Fate R Destiny, push the wave and create a numbers advantage in another lane. You remain squishy in the late game, so deal damage from the back and keep moving as you fight.
Annie.teamfight: If Annie is missing or Annie P Pyromania's stun is ready, stand together with your allies so you are not hit by the area stun from Annie R Summon: Tibbers. Use Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards from the back, and use the yellow card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card on enemies who engage.
Annie.watch: If white light swirls around Annie, Annie P Pyromania's stun is ready, so stay outside her ability range. After being hit by Annie R Summon: Tibbers, keep your distance to avoid the summoned Tibbers's damage over time.

Aphelios.build: Survive the early game with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps. Aphelios deals mostly physical damage, and Twisted Fate has relatively low armor, so build armor first. If poke is continually erased by healing from Aphelios E Weapon Queue System and Aphelios R Moonlight Vigil, consider Morellonomicon after completing one core item.
Aphelios.combo: From within reach of Aphelios, lock in the yellow card with Twisted Fate W Pick a Card, stun him with an auto attack, then follow with Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards and another auto attack.
Aphelios.escape: Engage after dodging the slow from Gravitum on Aphelios E Weapon Queue System and the root from Aphelios Q Weapon Abilites. When he is not holding Severum, his only escape is Flash, so close the gap with Twisted Fate R Destiny and apply the stun from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card. To avoid having your travel interrupted, start reactivating Twisted Fate R Destiny from a spot outside enemy vision.
Aphelios.fight: Check the next weapon shown on Aphelios E Weapon Queue System and trade during weapon windows with low burst damage. When he is not holding Severum, close the gap with Twisted Fate R Destiny and stun him with the yellow card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card. If you are slowed by Gravitum, back away first to avoid the root from Aphelios Q Weapon Abilites.
Aphelios.laning: Take an angle beside the wave to target Aphelios without being blocked by the frontline minions. Use the time after pushing to establish vision, and after learning Twisted Fate R Destiny, move to another lane to create a numbers advantage.
Aphelios.phase: In midgame, after learning Twisted Fate R Destiny, your ability to push and roam becomes strong, but Aphelios's fighting strength depends on his current weapon. Twisted Fate remains squishy in the late game, so deal damage from the backline and keep moving as you fight.
Aphelios.teamfight: Spread out from your allies before engaging so fewer of you are hit by Aphelios R Moonlight Vigil. Use Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards from the back, and stop enemies who dive onto your allies with the yellow card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card. When Aphelios is not holding Severum, look for a chance to stun him with your allies.
Aphelios.watch: If you are slowed by a Gravitum auto attack from Aphelios E Weapon Queue System, get out of range before being hit by the root from Aphelios Q Weapon Abilites. If you are marked by Calibrum, immediately back away because Aphelios can attack you from beyond his normal range. Aphelios R Moonlight Vigil triggers one additional attack from his main-hand weapon for each champion hit, so spread out from your allies when he can use it.

Ashe.build: Ashe deals mostly physical damage, and Twisted Fate has relatively low armor, so build armor first. Survive the early game with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps.
Ashe.combo: When engaging with Twisted Fate R Destiny, reveal the area first, lock in the yellow card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card, then reactivate R. From close range in lane, chain yellow card locked in → stun auto attack → Q → auto attack.
Ashe.escape: The window to approach is after Ashe W Volley is down and Ashe Q Ranger's Focus has ended. Ashe has no ability to create distance, so close the gap in one go with Twisted Fate R Destiny and catch her with the yellow card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card. Do not start a small fight from out of sight while Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow is available, and begin R's travel from a spot outside enemy vision where it cannot be interrupted.
Ashe.fight: Try to trade right after Ashe W Volley is down. When Ashe Q Ranger's Focus is active, create distance; after it ends, look to stun her with the yellow card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card. Avoid getting caught by Ashe P Frost Shot by not walking into auto-attack range and staying there for long.
Ashe.laning: Throw Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards from an angle beside the wave to clear the backline, then establish vision or roam while the lane is pushed. Lock in the yellow card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card within auto-attack range and use it right away; do not hold it throughout laning.
Ashe.phase: After learning Twisted Fate R Destiny, create a numbers advantage in other lanes by roaming. You remain squishy in the late game, so contribute damage from the backline and look for chances to reposition.
Ashe.teamfight: Hold your position at the back and throw Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards. Stop enemies who dive onto your allies with the yellow card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card. Even if you have an angle to reach Ashe, do not walk in first and remain exposed to her auto-attack slow for long.
Ashe.watch: Ashe W Volley slows in an area, so dodge to the side of its cone. Ashe P Frost Shot's slow is refreshed with each auto attack, so do not stay within auto-attack range for long. Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow flies in a straight line and stuns, so change direction as you move, and do not start a small fight from out of sight while her ultimate is available.

AurelionSol.build: Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads for your boots. Prioritize magic resistance since Aurelion Sol deals mostly magic damage, but avoid stacking only health because Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light deals damage based on your maximum health.
AurelionSol.combo: Take advantage of Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight being down to lock in the gold card with Twisted Fate W Pick a Card and move into auto-attack range. When roaming, reveal vision with Twisted Fate R Destiny, lock in the gold card, then travel; on arrival, land a stun auto and Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards immediately.
AurelionSol.escape: Immediately after Aurelion Sol has spent W Astral Flight is your chance to close the gap; you can approach with Twisted Fate R Destiny and land the gold card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card. Crowd control cancels Twisted Fate R Destiny's travel, so cast it outside enemy vision to avoid being interrupted by Aurelion Sol E Singularity or Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend.
AurelionSol.fight: After Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight is down, stun him with the gold card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card and deal a quick burst of damage.
AurelionSol.laning: Clear the backline with Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards to push the wave first, then secure vision or move to another lane while Aurelion Sol catches the wave. Stardust from Aurelion Sol P Cosmic Creator remains even after death, so do not absorb meaningless poke. Pressure him after Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight is down to slow his early scaling.
AurelionSol.phase: In the mid game, push the lane and roam after learning Twisted Fate R Destiny to snowball your gains. In the late game, Aurelion Sol's permanent Stardust accumulates and puts you at a disadvantage, so do not expect the same engage angles; fight from the backline.
AurelionSol.teamfight: Twisted Fate deals damage from the backline with Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards and stops enemies diving onto allies with the gold card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card. After Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend is empowered, do not overlap with allies or bunch up in narrow passages. Even if you have no angle to travel, you can use Twisted Fate R Destiny to gain vision and tell your team where the enemies are.
AurelionSol.watch: Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light deals damage based on your maximum health, and staying in it builds up extra damage and Stardust, so stand behind minions and quickly move out of its targeting line. When low on health, avoid the edge of Aurelion Sol E Singularity, which can execute you, and walk out immediately if caught. In the late game, keep your distance from allies so you are not hit together by the AoE knock-up from Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend.

Aurora.build: Aurora's main damage is magic, and Twisted Fate has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. Early on, survive with Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury's Treads for your boots. If Aurora P Spirit Abjuration keeps healing away your poke, fit Morellonomicon into your build after completing one core item.
Aurora.combo: Lock in the gold card with Twisted Fate W Pick a Card, then move into auto-attack range and use a stun auto, Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards, then an auto. You must use a locked-in card within 6 seconds, so choose it from a distance where you can reach your target.
Aurora.escape: If only one of Aurora W Across the Veil and Aurora E The Weirding is down, she can still escape with the other mobility spell, so do not engage too hastily. Look to close the gap with Twisted Fate R Destiny and catch her with the gold card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card when Aurora R Between Worlds is not yet back up and her other mobility spell is also down. R's travel can be canceled by crowd control, so cast it from a spot outside enemy vision.
Aurora.fight: Avoid trades that also involve taking the recall damage from Aurora Q Twofold Hex when health has already been reduced. If Aurora disappears with Aurora W Across the Veil, do not rush to use the gold card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card; wait for her to reappear. If Aurora uses her mobility to engage and fails to get a takedown, look for a chance to catch her with the gold card.
Aurora.laning: Early on, Twisted Fate should focus on pushing the wave first instead of taking a head-on fight. Angle Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards to clear the backline, then secure vision or roam while Aurora catches the pushed wave. Use the blue card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card if you need mana, and do not stand around holding the gold card for too long.
Aurora.phase: After learning Twisted Fate R Destiny, pushing the lane and creating a numbers advantage in another lane becomes a strong way to play. You are still fragile in the late game, so deal damage from the backline and keep moving as you fight.
Aurora.teamfight: Twisted Fate uses Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards from the backline and stops Aurora from diving onto allies with the gold card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card. If Aurora gets a takedown, Aurora W Across the Veil's cooldown resets, so do not leave low-health allies behind when retreating. If Aurora leaps in and fails to kill anyone, look for a chance to catch her then.
Aurora.watch: Aurora Q Twofold Hex deals damage again when recalled, and that damage increases with the amount of missing health. If cursed, move out of the line between you and Aurora, and if low on health, retreat before the recall. You are slowed if you leave Aurora R Between Worlds after it appears, so create distance before the zone forms.

Azir.build: Early on, survive by buying Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads for your boots. Azir deals mostly magic damage and Twisted Fate has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Azir.combo: After Azir E Shifting Sands is down, lock in the gold card with Twisted Fate W Pick a Card and move into auto-attack range.
Azir.escape: Azir E Shifting Sands is his mobility, so the moment after you make him use it is your window to engage. Close the gap with Twisted Fate R Destiny and catch him with the gold card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card. If Azir summons a soldier over a wall, he is preparing an escape route with Azir E Shifting Sands, so watch for that direction as you engage.
Azir.fight: Do not take extended trades where Azir's soldiers are still in position. After Azir moves his soldiers with Azir Q Conquering Sands, go around to the side and close in on him for a quick burst when the soldiers have stopped or Azir E Shifting Sands is down. Lock in the gold card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card within auto-attack range and use it immediately to stun him.
Azir.laning: Send Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards at an angle beside the wave to clear the backline, then secure vision or roam while Azir catches the pushed wave. Pressure him with your jungler when his soldiers disappear or mana is depleted.
Azir.phase: After learning Twisted Fate R Destiny, pushing the lane and creating a numbers advantage in another lane becomes a strong way to play. Azir gets stronger as the game goes on, so in the late game, Twisted Fate should contribute damage from the backline and keep moving because he is fragile.
Azir.teamfight: Twisted Fate uses Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards from the backline and stops enemies diving onto allies with the gold card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card. Avoid narrow passages and approach from multiple directions across a wide area so your team does not get knocked back together by Azir R Emperor's Divide. Even if you have no angle to move in, use the vision from Twisted Fate R Destiny to tell your team where Azir and the enemy jungler are.
Azir.watch: Azir's soldiers summoned by Azir W Arise! are the main source of his damage, so move to the side and out of the soldiers' line. After Azir moves his soldiers with Azir Q Conquering Sands, approach based on where they stop. In narrow passages, Azir R Emperor's Divide can knock back those engaging and use its soldier wall to block the follow-up, so do not group up when entering.

Cassiopeia.build: Cassiopeia deals mostly magic damage and Twisted Fate has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury's Treads for your boots. If Cassiopeia E Twin Fang's healing keeps erasing your poke, fit Morellonomicon into your build after completing one core item.
Cassiopeia.combo: At close range, lock in the gold card with Twisted Fate W Pick a Card, move into auto-attack range, and stun her with an auto, then follow up with Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards and an auto. When engaging with Twisted Fate R Destiny, reveal vision first, lock in the gold card, then recast R to travel. Stun her with an auto immediately on arrival and land Q.
Cassiopeia.escape: Cassiopeia has no mobility, so the moment she uses Cassiopeia W Miasma elsewhere is your chance to engage. Use Twisted Fate R Destiny from outside enemy vision and stun her with the gold card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card immediately on arrival. If a poison cloud is already on the ground, do not rely on R; walk out instead.
Cassiopeia.fight: If you are hit by Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast, close the gap again after the poison ends. When an opportunity to get close comes up, stun her with the gold card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card, then deal damage.
Cassiopeia.laning: Focus on pushing the wave before looking for kills. Clear the backline with Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards, then use the time you have after pushing to roam or secure vision. When looking for Cassiopeia, lock in the gold card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card at a distance where you can reach her with an auto-attack.
Cassiopeia.phase: After learning Twisted Fate R Destiny, push the lane and join another lane to build an advantage. Cassiopeia's sustained damage gets stronger in the mid to late game, so Twisted Fate should contribute damage from the backline because he remains fragile.
Cassiopeia.teamfight: From the far backline, throw out Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards and stop enemies diving onto allies with the gold card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card. When engaging Cassiopeia, do not push in head-on; check the approach route or look for the moment after she uses Cassiopeia W Miasma elsewhere. If an opportunity comes up, stun her first with the gold card and attack before she gains movement speed.
Cassiopeia.watch: If you are poisoned by Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast, both the damage and healing from Cassiopeia E Twin Fang increase, so stay out of range until the poison ends. When you see Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze's cast animation, turn away to avoid being stunned. You cannot use Twisted Fate R Destiny inside Cassiopeia W Miasma, so do not step into the cloud.

Diana.build: Diana deals mostly magic damage and Twisted Fate has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. Early on, survive with Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury's Treads for your boots.
Diana.combo: After Diana engages with Diana E Lunar Rush without Q, lock in the gold card with Twisted Fate W Pick a Card, stun her with an auto, then follow up with Q Wild Cards and an auto.
Diana.escape: Right after Diana uses Diana E Lunar Rush without a mark is your window to engage. At that point, to close the gap with Twisted Fate R Destiny, recast it from outside enemy vision, then use the gold card from W Pick a Card when you arrive. If a mark from Diana Q Crescent Strike remains on you, she can engage again with E, so create distance.
Diana.fight: Dodge Diana Q Crescent Strike and trade after the orbs and shield from Diana W Pale Cascade are down. If Diana engages first with Diana E Lunar Rush without Q, stun her with the gold card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card and counterattack. If you are hit by Q and marked, create distance instead of trying to catch her.
Diana.laning: If Diana stands behind minions, angle Q to send it beside the wave.
Diana.phase: After Twisted Fate learns R Destiny, push the lane and create a numbers advantage in another lane. You are still fragile in the late game, so deal damage from the backline and keep moving as you fight.
Diana.teamfight: Keep your distance from allies based on Diana R Moonfall's engage angle so several of you are not pulled in together. Use vision to check Diana's flank routes, and throw Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards from the backline. If Diana dives onto an ally, stop her with the gold card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card.
Diana.watch: Diana Q Crescent Strike curves as it flies, so dodge to the side instead of retreating in a straight line. If you are hit and marked, Diana can re-engage with Diana E Lunar Rush, so create distance. Do not fight up close while the orbs and shield from Diana W Pale Cascade remain.

Ekko.build: Ekko deals mostly magic damage, and Twisted Fate has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. Early on, survive with a Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. If Ekko R Chronobreak's healing keeps erasing your poke, fit Morellonomicon in after completing one core item.
Ekko.combo: From within range to hit Ekko, lock in the gold card with Twisted Fate W Pick a Card, then stun him with a basic attack and follow with Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards and a basic attack.
Ekko.escape: Don't go in just because Ekko E Phase Dive is down. Look for a window before Ekko R Chronobreak comes back, and if Ekko W Parallel Convergence is down too, use Twisted Fate R Destiny to close the gap. Then stun him with the gold card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card to limit his chance to escape.
Ekko.fight: Keep your distance and poke with Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards instead of fighting Ekko head-on for too long. Right after Ekko E Phase Dive closes in, respond with the gold card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card to stun him. While Ekko R Chronobreak is down, use Twisted Fate R Destiny to close the gap and find a chance to fight.
Ekko.laning: Against melee Ekko, keep poking from outside Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards' range, but don't stand forward without Twisted Fate W Pick a Card available. Throw Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards diagonally beside the wave to poke Ekko standing behind it and clear the backline minions as well. After pushing the lane first, secure vision or move to another lane while Ekko catches the wave.
Ekko.phase: After learning Twisted Fate R Destiny, use vision and rotations to create a numbers advantage in another lane, and look for windows while Ekko R Chronobreak is down. Twisted Fate is still fragile in the late game, so deal damage from the back and keep your position safe.
Ekko.teamfight: Throw Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards from the farthest backline, and if Ekko closes in on an ally with Ekko E Phase Dive, interrupt him with the gold card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card. Avoid the area where you saw the tell for Ekko W Parallel Convergence, and if Ekko R Chronobreak is ready, don't chase just because he's low. Fight from a position that stops Ekko's engage instead of going in deep first.
Ekko.watch: When you see the tell for Ekko W Parallel Convergence, stay out of its area to avoid the stun and shield. Watch the direction Ekko Q Timewinder flies, then sidestep its return path too. If you see Ekko's afterimage behind him, Ekko R Chronobreak is ready, so don't chase recklessly even if he's low.

Ezreal.build: Prioritize movement speed to close the gap, and consider attack speed reduction to reduce Ezreal's basic attack damage. Ezreal Q Mystic Shot deals physical damage, while Ezreal W Essence Flux and Ezreal E Arcane Shift deal magic damage, so don't stack resistance in just one direction.
Ezreal.combo: When Ezreal E Arcane Shift is down, use Twisted Fate R Destiny from out of sight to reveal the area, then lock in the gold card with Twisted Fate W Pick a Card. Use the locked-in card with a basic attack within 6 seconds.
Ezreal.escape: The moment Ezreal E Arcane Shift is down is your window to go in. Ezreal has no crowd control, so approach at an angle that blocks his escape route and catch him with Twisted Fate R Destiny and the stun from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card.
Ezreal.fight: Start with a short engage to draw out Ezreal E Arcane Shift, then close the gap and fight right after it's down. If Ezreal Q Mystic Shot keeps hitting you, his escape comes back quickly, so move with minions between you. When you can get close, stun him with the gold card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card and continue the trade.
Ezreal.laning: Early on, focus on pushing the wave first with Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards rather than taking a head-on fight, creating time to roam and secure vision. Dodge Ezreal Q Mystic Shot with minions between you, and angle Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards beside the wave when aiming for Ezreal standing behind it. Instead of holding the gold card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card for too long, lock it in when you can get within basic attack range.
Ezreal.phase: Twisted Fate is weak in head-on fights early, so push the lane instead of trading blows with Ezreal. You're still fragile late, so contribute damage from the back and look for chances to move.
Ezreal.teamfight: Deal damage with Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards from the farthest backline, then interrupt enemies diving onto your allies with the gold card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card. Secure vision and an approach angle instead of trading poke with Ezreal from far away, and look for a chance to close in when Ezreal E Arcane Shift is down. When retreating at low health, avoid lining up with your allies to help dodge Ezreal R Trueshot Barrage.
Ezreal.watch: If Ezreal Q Mystic Shot keeps hitting you, Ezreal E Arcane Shift comes back sooner, so dodge with minions between you. If Ezreal W Essence Flux hits you, his next attack triggers bonus damage, so briefly step out of range. When low on health, retreat at an angle to avoid the straight path of Ezreal R Trueshot Barrage.

Fizz.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first to survive the early game. Fizz deals mostly magic damage, and Twisted Fate has relatively low magic resistance, so prioritize magic resistance and choose Mercury's Treads for boots.
Fizz.combo: If Fizz E Playful / Trickster is down, lock in the gold card with Twisted Fate W Pick a Card and approach within basic attack range. You must use the locked-in card within 6 seconds, so choose it when you can reach him.
Fizz.escape: Your window to engage is before Fizz E Playful / Trickster comes back. If Fizz Q Urchin Strike is still available, don't force an engage just because one mobility spell is down. When closing the gap, use Twisted Fate R Destiny from out of the opponent's vision, then stun Fizz with the gold card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card.
Fizz.fight: Use the moment after Fizz E Playful / Trickster is down to counterattack with the stun from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card and Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards. Look for a trade when Fizz misses a last hit with the empowered basic attack from Fizz W Seastone Trident and its full cooldown begins.
Fizz.laning: Early on, keep your distance, poke with Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards, and push the wave first instead of fighting head-on. Don't stand forward if you don't have the gold card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card to escape when Fizz closes in. Use the time after pushing the lane to roam or secure vision.
Fizz.phase: After learning Twisted Fate R Destiny, push the lane and create a numbers advantage in another lane. You're still fragile late, so contribute damage from the back and fight while repositioning.
Fizz.teamfight: Stand close to your allies to bait out Fizz E Playful / Trickster, then focus him once it's down. From the backline, use Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards, and if Fizz dives in, stop him with the gold card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card. If Fizz R Chum the Waters' fish attaches to you, move away from your allies before the shark erupts.
Fizz.watch: Fizz E Playful / Trickster can be used both to engage and to escape, so save Twisted Fate W Pick a Card's stun until it's down. If Fizz R Chum the Waters' fish attaches to you, move away from your allies before the shark erupts.

Galio.build: Galio deals mostly magic damage, and Twisted Fate has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. Buy a Null-Magic Mantle early and choose Mercury's Treads for boots.
Galio.combo: Lock in the gold card with Twisted Fate W Pick a Card, enter basic attack range to stun Galio, then follow with Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards and a basic attack.
Galio.escape: Don't go in just because Galio E Justice Punch is down. Look for a window before Galio R Hero's Entrance comes back, when Galio's other mobility and crowd control are down too, and use Twisted Fate R Destiny to close the gap. After going in, stun him with the gold card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card.
Galio.fight: Take advantage of Galio being melee by poking from outside Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards' range. Back away while Galio W Shield of Durand charges, and stun him with the gold card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card after his crowd control and mobility are down.
Galio.laning: Focus on pushing the wave first instead of going for a kill. Throw Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards diagonally along the side of the wave to poke Galio behind it, and push the lane once Galio has spent mana using his abilities to clear the wave. Don't stand in front of Galio without the gold card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card available.
Galio.phase: After learning Twisted Fate R Destiny, push the lane and create a numbers advantage elsewhere, but don't start a skirmish there while Galio R Hero's Entrance is ready. Twisted Fate is still fragile late, so fight from the backline.
Galio.teamfight: Use Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards from the backline and stop enemies diving onto your allies with the gold card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card. If you see the landing marker for Galio R Hero's Entrance, immediately leave the area. While Galio W Shield of Durand is charging, don't unload your damage; move outside taunt range.
Galio.watch: When Galio W Shield of Durand is charging, don't unload your damage; walk out of taunt range. Dodge Galio E Justice Punch when you see its windup as he steps back, and avoid the spot where the two gusts from Galio Q Winds of War overlap. If you see the landing marker for Galio R Hero's Entrance, immediately leave the area.

Hwei.build: Early on, buy a Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Hwei deals mostly magic damage, so prioritize magic resistance. Hwei Q Subject: Disaster deals damage based on your maximum health, so avoid choices that only greatly increase your health.
Hwei.combo: For a basic trade, lock in the gold card with Twisted Fate W Pick a Card and approach within basic attack range, then use this sequence: basic attack stun → Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards → basic attack.
Hwei.escape: Hwei has no mobility spell, so the moment after Hwei E Subject: Torment is used is your chance to close the gap. Recast Twisted Fate R Destiny from out of the opponent's vision to move, then catch Hwei after landing with the gold card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card. Wait if Hwei E is still available, since a root or forced movement can interrupt your engage.
Hwei.fight: Early on, avoid head-on fights and focus on pushing the wave. Right after Hwei E Subject: Torment is used to poke or clear the wave, stun him with the gold card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card and follow with Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards. Hwei W Subject: Serenity can increase his movement speed, so lock in the gold card when you're close enough to reach basic attack range.
Hwei.laning: Use Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards to clear the backline minions and push the wave first. While Hwei catches the pushed wave, secure vision or move to another lane. If Hwei has placed an eye, change your gank path or send minions ahead to trigger it first.
Hwei.phase: After learning Twisted Fate R Destiny, push the wave and turn the advantage into a lead by creating a numbers advantage in another lane. You're still fragile late, so deal damage from the back and fight while repositioning.
Hwei.teamfight: Throw out Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards from the very back and use the gold card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card on enemies diving onto your allies. Don't engage first if Hwei E Subject: Torment is still available. After Hwei uses E, look for a chance to close the gap with Twisted Fate R Destiny.
Hwei.watch: If you're rooted or pulled by Hwei E Subject: Torment, you can be hit by follow-up attacks, so don't engage while Hwei E is available. If Hwei's first spell hits you, move immediately to avoid the second spell and the explosion from Hwei P Signature of the Visionary. Don't stay in an area covered by Hwei Q Subject: Disaster or in a narrow passage.

Irelia.build: Survive early with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Irelia deals mostly physical damage, and Twisted Fate has relatively low armor, so build armor first. If Irelia Q Bladesurge's healing keeps erasing your poke, fit Morellonomicon in after completing one core item.
Irelia.combo: After Irelia Q Bladesurge is down, lock in the gold card with Twisted Fate W Pick a Card and approach within basic attack range.
Irelia.escape: The moment after making Irelia use Irelia Q Bladesurge is your chance to go in. Close the gap with Twisted Fate R Destiny and use the gold card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card to keep her from escaping. Crowd control can cancel Twisted Fate R Destiny's movement, so cast it from a spot the opponent can't see.
Irelia.fight: Don't trade from the front when Irelia has a minion she can use Irelia Q Bladesurge on to close in. Right after making her use Irelia Q Bladesurge, close the gap and stun her with the gold card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card, then hit her with Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards.
Irelia.laning: In lane, focus on pushing the wave first instead of going for a kill. Use Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards to clear the backline, but angle them along the side of the wave when poking Irelia behind it. Don't leave a half-health minion between you and Irelia, and use time after pushing to roam or secure vision.
Irelia.phase: After learning Twisted Fate R Destiny, push the lane and join another lane to build your lead. Twisted Fate is still fragile late, so deal damage from the back and fight while repositioning.
Irelia.teamfight: In teamfights, use Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards from the backline and prioritize Irelia as your target. If Irelia dives onto an ally, stop her with the gold card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card. Irelia R Vanguard's Edge can cut across the fight and Irelia E Flawless Duet can stun multiple enemies, so hold your backline position instead of stepping forward first.
Irelia.watch: Irelia Q Bladesurge can chain onto low-health minions to close in, so step back when minions are about to die. Watch out for the stun from Irelia E Flawless Duet, and if you're caught in Irelia R Vanguard's Edge's barrier, wait until the blades disappear.

Jhin.build: Jhin's main damage is physical, and Twisted Fate has relatively low armor, so build armor first. Survive early with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots.
Jhin.combo: For a basic fight, lock in the gold card with Twisted Fate W Pick a Card and approach within basic attack range to stun Jhin, then follow with Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards and a basic attack. You must use the locked-in card with a basic attack within 6 seconds.
Jhin.escape: Jhin has no ability to create distance on his own, so if you've dodged Jhin W Deadly Flourish and he's reloading, it's your chance to engage. When approaching with Twisted Fate R Destiny, start the movement from a spot the opponent can't see to avoid having it canceled by crowd control.
Jhin.fight: Close the gap while Jhin is reloading or after he's fired one or two shots. Jhin has no ability to create distance on his own, so if you have a safe angle to approach, stun him with the gold card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card and then hit him with Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards.
Jhin.laning: If you stand beside a low-health minion, Jhin Q Dancing Grenade can bounce off it after killing it and grow stronger, so stand away from the wave. Angle Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards to clear the backline minions and push the lane first. Use that time to roam or secure vision, but be careful not to get rooted by Jhin W Deadly Flourish while standing on a trap.
Jhin.phase: After learning Twisted Fate R Destiny, push the lane and move when Jhin has little chance to escape to build an advantage in another lane. You're still fragile late, so contribute damage from the back and look for opportunities to move.
Jhin.teamfight: Use Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards from the very back, then stop enemies diving onto your allies with the gold card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card. If you need to advance toward Jhin, follow only after your frontline has taken Jhin W Deadly Flourish and the traps first. When you're not at full health, dodge Jhin R Curtain Call; if someone needs to block the shots, the ally with the highest health percentage should do it.
Jhin.watch: The last shot of Jhin P Whisper deals heavy damage, so count his remaining shots and back off when he has his last one. Right after you're hit by Jhin's basic attack or a trap, dodge the narrow straight-line attack from Jhin W Deadly Flourish. When low on health, dodge the shots from Jhin R Curtain Call, which deal more damage based on your missing health.

Jinx.build: Survive early with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Jinx's main damage is physical, and Twisted Fate has relatively low armor, so build armor first.
Jinx.combo: When engaging, use Twisted Fate R Destiny to gain vision, lock in the gold card with Twisted Fate W Pick a Card, then recast R.
Jinx.escape: Engage when Jinx E Flame Chompers! has missed or has already been used. If Jinx W Zap! has also missed, it's your chance to close the gap with Twisted Fate R Destiny and pin her down with the gold card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card.
Jinx.fight: If Jinx has been poking with rockets and has no minigun stacks, and Jinx E Flame Chompers! has been used, close the gap and stun her with the gold card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card.
Jinx.laning: Avoid standing right next to minions when Jinx attacks them with rockets, so you don't also get hit by the area damage. Angle Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards to reach Jinx behind the wave, and push the wave first to roam or secure vision.
Jinx.phase: After learning Twisted Fate R Destiny, push the lane and create a numbers advantage elsewhere. You're still fragile late, so contribute damage from the back, and don't start a fight right after Jinx P Get Excited! activates.
Jinx.teamfight: Use Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards from the backline and stop enemies engaging on your allies with the gold card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card. Look for an opening to engage after Jinx E Flame Chompers! or Jinx W Zap! is down. Avoid fighting right after Jinx P Get Excited! activates when an ally dies or a turret is destroyed.
Jinx.watch: Being rooted by Jinx E Flame Chompers! stops your engage, so look for an opening after the traps miss or have been used. Dodge the slow from Jinx W Zap!, and if health has been reduced, stay out of the finishing range of Jinx R Super Mega Death Rocket!.

Kaisa.build: Early on, buy Cloth Armor first and choose Plated Steelcaps for your boots. Kai'Sa's main damage is physical, so build armor first. Armor won't block the magic damage from Kai'Sa P Second Skin or Kai'Sa W Void Seeker, so if you can't stop her engage in one go, build magic resistance and health as well.
Kaisa.combo: Lock in a gold card with Twisted Fate W Pick a Card, then move within basic attack range to stun her and follow up with Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards and basic attacks. You must use the locked-in card with a basic attack within 6 seconds, so choose it when you're close enough to reach her.
Kaisa.escape: While Kai'Sa R Killer Instinct is down, close the distance with Twisted Fate R Destiny and stun her with the gold card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card.
Kaisa.fight: When Kai'Sa R Killer Instinct is down, stun her with the gold card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card, then follow up with Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards and basic attacks.
Kaisa.laning: Use Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards to clear the backline minions and push the wave first, then use that time to roam or establish vision. When you expect Kai'Sa Q Icathian Rain, stand near an allied minion; if Kai'Sa W Void Seeker hits you, retreat until the mark disappears. Use the blue card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card to restore mana and the red card to clear waves.
Kaisa.phase: Once you've learned Twisted Fate R Destiny, push the lane and create a numbers advantage in another lane. Twisted Fate is still fragile in the late game, so add damage from the backline and keep moving as you fight.
Kaisa.teamfight: Use Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards from the back, then stun Kai'Sa with the gold card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card if she dives in. It's important to stop her engage before the shield from Kai'Sa R Killer Instinct is stripped away. Before a fight, place Control Wards in side bushes and along entry paths to prepare for Kai'Sa E Supercharge's stealth engage.
Kaisa.watch: Immediately after Kai'Sa W Void Seeker hits, Kai'Sa can dive in with Kai'Sa R Killer Instinct, so retreat toward your allies until the mark disappears. If stacks of Kai'Sa P Second Skin are applied, its damage increases as your health gets lower, so stay out of range until the stacks wear off. When Kai'Sa looks ready to use Kai'Sa Q Icathian Rain, stand near an allied minion so the missiles spread out.

Kalista.build: Early on, hold out with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps for your boots. Build armor first to counter the physical damage from Kalista Q Pierce and Kalista E Rend.
Kalista.combo: When you can reach basic attack range, lock in a gold card with Twisted Fate W Pick a Card, move in, then use this sequence: basic attack stun → Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards → basic attack.
Kalista.escape: Kalista P Martial Poise's leap is still available, so catch her with the gold card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card while you're within reach.
Kalista.fight: Rather than throwing Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards based on Kalista P Martial Poise's leaps, aim for the moment her basic attack windup begins.
Kalista.laning: Focus on pushing the wave before looking for kills. Angle Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards to clear the backline, then roam or establish vision while Kalista catches the pushed wave. If several spears are lodged in you, leave the lane until they disappear.
Kalista.phase: Early on, Twisted Fate has low attack damage and survivability, so direct fights are unfavorable. You're still fragile in the late game, so add damage from the backline and look for chances to reposition.
Kalista.teamfight: Use Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards from the back, then stop enemies diving onto your allies with the gold card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card.
Kalista.watch: If Kalista's basic attacks stack several spears in you, one cast of Kalista E Rend can deal heavy damage, so don't keep fighting with stacks built up.

Karma.build: Karma's main damage is magic, so buy a Null-Magic Mantle first early on and choose Mercury's Treads. Twisted Fate's magic damage is effective against Karma, so build magic resistance first to withstand her damage. If poke keeps getting erased by the healing from Karma W empowered by Karma R Mantra, fit Morellonomicon into your build after completing one core item.
Karma.combo: While Karma W Focused Resolve is down, lock in a gold card with Twisted Fate W Pick a Card and approach to basic attack range to stun her. Follow up with Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards and basic attacks.
Karma.escape: The opening to engage comes after Karma W Focused Resolve is down and the shield from Karma E empowered by Karma R Mantra has ended. When closing the distance with Twisted Fate R Destiny, cast it from a spot outside the enemy's vision so Karma's root can't cancel your movement. Stun her with the gold card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card as soon as you land.
Karma.fight: Don't engage first while Karma W Focused Resolve is available; create distance and make her use it. Once W is down and the shield from Karma E empowered by Karma R Mantra has ended, stun her with the gold card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card, then follow up with Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards and basic attacks.
Karma.laning: Angle Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards past the side of the wave to clear the backline, and dodge Karma Q Inner Flame from behind minions or outside its range. Use the time after pushing the lane to roam or establish vision.
Karma.phase: From mid game, once you've learned Twisted Fate R Destiny, push the lane and join another lane to create a numbers advantage. You're still fragile in the late game, so add damage from the backline and look for chances to reposition.
Karma.teamfight: Throw Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards from the back, and use the gold card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card on enemies diving onto your allies. Delay your engage if Karma W Focused Resolve is available or the shield from Karma E empowered by Karma R Mantra is active. After Karma W is down and the shield has ended, stun an enemy to help your allies engage.
Karma.watch: Taking free hits from Karma Q Inner Flame gives her more chances to use R Mantra through Karma P Gathering Fire, so stand behind minions or outside its range. If you're hit by the burning ground from a Q empowered by Karma R Mantra, leave the area before it explodes. If Karma W Focused Resolve connects, create distance to break it before it roots you.

Kassadin.build: Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads for your boots. Kassadin's damage is mostly magic and Twisted Fate has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Kassadin.combo: After Kassadin Q Null Sphere is down, lock in a gold card with Twisted Fate W Pick a Card, approach to basic attack range, stun him, then follow up with Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards and a basic attack.
Kassadin.escape: At that point, close the distance with Twisted Fate R Destiny and stun him with the gold card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card. It's also a chance to counterattack when Kassadin has depleted his mana by using R repeatedly.
Kassadin.fight: When Kassadin Q Null Sphere is down or just after Kassadin uses Kassadin R Riftwalk, stun him with the gold card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card and deal damage. Don't step forward to fight him head-on when you don't have a gold card.
Kassadin.laning: Use Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards to clear the backline minions and push the wave first, then establish vision or move to another lane while Kassadin farms under his turret. Unnecessary ability use near Kassadin reduces the cooldown of Kassadin E Force Pulse, so clear the wave from outside his range whenever possible.
Kassadin.phase: Once Twisted Fate has learned R Destiny, push the lane and create a numbers advantage in another lane. In the late game, Kassadin R Riftwalk can make a dangerous flank, so don't stand alone and stay toward the back.
Kassadin.teamfight: Stay in position and throw Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards from the back. If Kassadin uses Kassadin R Riftwalk to enter your team's backline, stop his engage with the gold card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card. Don't stand alone within range of Kassadin R Riftwalk.
Kassadin.watch: Kassadin Q Null Sphere grants a shield that absorbs magic damage, so hit him with Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards while that ability is down.

KogMaw.build: Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads for your boots. Kog'Maw's main ability damage is magic, so build magic resistance first, but get some armor too to account for his physical damage from basic attacks.
KogMaw.combo: Lock in a gold card with Twisted Fate W Pick a Card, approach to basic attack range, stun him with a basic attack, then follow up with Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards and a basic attack.
KogMaw.escape: The opening to close the distance comes after Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage expires. Dodge the slow from Kog'Maw E Void Ooze, then use Twisted Fate R Destiny to approach Kog'Maw, who has no mobility ability, and land the gold card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card. Twisted Fate R Destiny's movement is canceled if interrupted, so cast it from a spot outside the enemy's vision.
KogMaw.fight: Avoid trading while Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage is active; approach after it expires. If Kog'Maw Q Caustic Spittle hits you, don't engage while your resistances are reduced. When you get an opening, stun him with the gold card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card and deal damage.
KogMaw.laning: Establish vision or move to another lane while Kog'Maw catches the pushed wave. When aiming Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards at Kog'Maw, angle them past the side of the wave.
KogMaw.phase: Early on, Twisted Fate is weak in direct fights, so hold out while pushing the wave. From mid game, once you've learned Twisted Fate R Destiny, create numbers advantages with roams and secure objectives and turrets. Kog'Maw gets stronger as the game goes on, so play to end the game quickly; in the late game, Twisted Fate should protect his fragile body and fight from the backline.
KogMaw.teamfight: In teamfights, use Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards from the back and stop enemies diving onto your allies with the gold card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card. If an ally can engage, prioritize Kog'Maw, who has no mobility ability. After killing Kog'Maw, walk backward to avoid the explosion from Kog'Maw P Icathian Surprise.
KogMaw.watch: When Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage is active, Kog'Maw's attack range and basic attack damage increase, so keep your distance until it expires. Kog'Maw Q Caustic Spittle reduces armor and magic resistance, so block it with minions or dodge to the side; if it hits you, don't engage right away. When health is low, leave vision to avoid Kog'Maw R Living Artillery. After killing Kog'Maw, move away from his corpse to avoid the explosion from Kog'Maw P Icathian Surprise.

Leblanc.build: Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads for your boots. LeBlanc's main damage is magic, so build magic resistance.
Leblanc.combo: After LeBlanc W Distortion's return expires or has been used, lock in a gold card with Twisted Fate W Pick a Card.
Leblanc.escape: The opening to engage comes right after you force LeBlanc to use LeBlanc W Distortion. Approach once its return expires or has already been used, and be careful not to let the root from LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains interrupt Twisted Fate R Destiny. If the chain hits you, use Twisted Fate R Destiny to get outside its range before it roots you.
Leblanc.fight: Close the distance after LeBlanc W Distortion's return expires or has already been used, then stun her with the gold card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card and deal damage.
Leblanc.laning: Angle Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards to clear the backline minions and push the lane first. If LeBlanc disappears from mid-lane vision, alert your team immediately, establish river vision, then move to a side lane. Use the time after pushing to roam or establish vision.
Leblanc.phase: Early on, Twisted Fate is weak in direct fights, so push the lane instead of fighting LeBlanc. You're still fragile in the late game, so contribute damage from the backline and create advantages through movement.
Leblanc.teamfight: Deal damage with Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards from the backmost position. If LeBlanc dives onto your allies, stop her with the gold card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card. Hold your backline position instead of engaging first.

Lissandra.build: Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads for your boots. Lissandra's damage is mostly magic, and she also has a root and a stun, so prioritize magic resistance and tenacity. If you face a team with lots of crowd control and Twisted Fate R Destiny is often interrupted, buy Quicksilver Sash.
Lissandra.combo: For a standard trade, lock in a gold card with Twisted Fate W Pick a Card, approach to basic attack range, then use this sequence: basic attack stun → Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards → basic attack. When roaming in after Lissandra E Glacial Path is down, use Twisted Fate R Destiny to reveal the area, lock in a gold card, then recast R Destiny to land and stun her immediately with a basic attack before using Q Wild Cards.
Lissandra.escape: Move in for a trade when Lissandra W Ring of Frost is down. If Lissandra E Glacial Path is also down, she has no escape; close the distance with Twisted Fate R Destiny and land the gold card. Twisted Fate R Destiny's movement can be canceled by crowd control, so cast it from a spot outside the enemy's vision.
Lissandra.fight: Avoid direct fights early, and trade right after Lissandra W Ring of Frost is used on the wave or misses. When Lissandra E Glacial Path is down, close the distance with Twisted Fate R Destiny and stun her with the gold card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card.
Lissandra.laning: Prioritize pushing the wave over getting kills. Angle Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards past the side of the wave to clear the backline, and stand at an angle to allied minions to avoid the piercing path of Lissandra Q Ice Shard. After pushing the lane, roam or establish vision.
Lissandra.phase: Early on, Twisted Fate is weak in direct fights, so avoid fighting Lissandra and push the wave. After learning Twisted Fate R Destiny, the strategy of pushing the lane and creating numbers advantages in other lanes becomes stronger. Twisted Fate is still fragile in the late game, so deal damage from the back and look for opportunities to move.
Lissandra.teamfight: Use Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards from the backmost position, then stop enemies diving onto your allies with the gold card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card. Check whether Lissandra E Glacial Path is down before deciding to engage. If Lissandra R Frozen Tomb is available, don't unload all your damage at once; attack again after the stasis from her self-cast R Frozen Tomb ends.
Lissandra.watch: Lissandra Q Ice Shard pierces after hitting its first target, so don't stand in a line with allied minions. Lissandra W Ring of Frost roots and Lissandra R Frozen Tomb stuns, making it easy to take repeated damage if you're caught, so don't get close while both abilities are available. If Lissandra uses Lissandra R Frozen Tomb on herself, she's immune to damage, so space out your attacks until the stasis ends.

Lucian.build: Early on, hold out with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps for your boots. Lucian's main damage is physical and Twisted Fate has low armor, so build armor first.
Lucian.combo: When Lucian E Relentless Pursuit is down, lock in a gold card with Twisted Fate W Pick a Card and approach to basic attack range.
Lucian.escape: Right after Lucian uses Lucian E Relentless Pursuit is your window to engage. Close the distance with Twisted Fate R Destiny from a spot outside the enemy's vision, and have the gold card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card ready to catch him after you land.
Lucian.fight: Avoid Lucian's first combo and counterattack after his abilities are down. Right after Lucian uses Lucian E Relentless Pursuit is your chance to catch him, so stun him with the gold card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card. Don't let basic attack trades drag on, because that quickly brings Lucian E Relentless Pursuit back up.
Lucian.laning: Use Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards to clear the backline, but don't stand behind minions that Lucian Q Piercing Light can pass through. Use the time after pushing the lane to establish vision or move to another lane.
Lucian.phase: Early on, Twisted Fate is weak in direct fights, so push the lane while avoiding Lucian's burst damage. You're still fragile in the late game, so attack from the backline and create advantages by moving.
Lucian.teamfight: Hold your position at the very back and use Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards. If Lucian dives onto your allies, stop him with the gold card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card. If you're exposed to Lucian R The Culling, sidestep out of its line of fire.
Lucian.watch: Lucian Q Piercing Light passes through minions and can reach beyond its marked range, so when Lucian targets a minion, step out of the line directly behind it. Lucian R The Culling cannot change direction during its cast, so move to the side instead of running straight back. Avoid trading when Lucian's first combo comes in.

Lux.build: Survive the early game with a Null-Magic Mantle, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Lux's main damage is magic, and Twisted Fate has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Lux.combo: After Lux Q Light Binding misses, use Twisted Fate W Pick a Card to lock in a gold card and move into basic attack range.
Lux.escape: When Lux Q Light Binding misses, look for an opening to engage. Lux has no mobility spell, so activate Twisted Fate R Destiny from an area without vision, lock in a gold card, then recast R to approach. Stun her with a basic attack as soon as you land.
Lux.fight: After dodging Lux Q Light Binding, fight with Twisted Fate W Pick a Card's gold card stun. If Lux's spell hits you, move out of her basic attack range to avoid the bonus damage from Lux P Illumination.
Lux.laning: Cast Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards diagonally beside the wave to clear the back line, then use the time you bought by pushing to roam or establish vision.
Lux.phase: After learning Twisted Fate R Destiny, push the lane and create a numbers advantage in other lanes to build on your gains. Even in the late game, you're fragile, so deal damage from the back and look for opportunities to move.
Lux.teamfight: Cast Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards from the back, then stop enemies diving onto your allies with Twisted Fate W Pick a Card's gold card. Don't bunch up with your allies and approach from one direction, so Lux E Lucent Singularity can't catch you all together.
Lux.watch: If Lux Q Light Binding hits you, her follow-up spells are likely to land too, so bait it out first and dodge. It roots the first two targets hit, so don't stand in a line with an ally. Dodge sideways when you see the red targeting line for Lux R Final Spark.

Malzahar.build: Survive the early game with a Null-Magic Mantle, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Malzahar's main damage is magic, so build magic resistance first. If you choose to greatly increase only your health, account for Malzahar R Nether Grasp's damage based on your maximum health.
Malzahar.combo: Use Twisted Fate W Pick a Card to remove Malzahar P Void Shift first, then lock in the gold card from a distance where you can move into basic attack range.
Malzahar.escape: Malzahar has no spell to create distance on his own, so look to engage when Malzahar P Void Shift has been removed and no Voidlings from Malzahar W Void Swarm are present. If you see Malzahar Q Call of the Void being cast, hold your spells until you've avoided the silence. When going in with Twisted Fate R Destiny, start moving from an area without vision.
Malzahar.fight: If Malzahar P Void Shift is active, remove it first with Twisted Fate W Pick a Card, then apply your stun and damage. If Malzahar W Void Swarm's Voidlings are active, clear them with an area spell such as Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards, and close the distance when they're gone or haven't been summoned yet.
Malzahar.laning: Stay away from minions affected by Malzahar E Malefic Visions. After removing Malzahar P Void Shift, go in with your jungler while Malzahar's lane is pushed in.
Malzahar.phase: Twisted Fate is weak in direct fights early, so push the wave to limit Malzahar's opportunities to build up.
Malzahar.teamfight: Cast Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards from the back, then stop enemies diving onto your allies with Twisted Fate W Pick a Card's gold card. If Malzahar W Void Swarm's Voidlings are active, clear them first with an area spell. If an ally is suppressed by Malzahar R Nether Grasp, interrupt the cast by applying immobilizing crowd control to Malzahar.
Malzahar.watch: When a minion affected by Malzahar E Malefic Visions dies, the effect spreads to a nearby enemy, so move away from that minion. When you see Malzahar Q Call of the Void, move outside the portals to avoid the silence. When Malzahar R Nether Grasp is available, don't cross areas without vision alone.

Mel.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Mel's main damage is magic, and Twisted Fate has low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Mel.combo: After Mel W Rebuttal is down, lock in a gold card with Twisted Fate W Pick a Card and move into basic attack range. When roaming, activate Twisted Fate R Destiny for vision, choose a gold card, then recast R to move.
Mel.escape: When Mel E Solar Snare and Mel W Rebuttal are down, look for an opening to engage. Mel has no mobility spell, so close the distance with Twisted Fate R Destiny and stun her with Twisted Fate W Pick a Card's gold card. The recast movement from R is interrupted if you're stopped, so start from an area without enemy vision.
Mel.fight: When Mel E Solar Snare and Mel W Rebuttal are down, hit Mel with Twisted Fate W Pick a Card's gold card basic attack, then follow with Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards and basic attacks.
Mel.laning: Clear the back-line minions with Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards to push the lane first. While Mel catches the pushed wave, establish vision or move to another lane to limit her opportunities to build up the scaling of Mel R Golden Eclipse. When aiming Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards at Mel, angle the cast from beside the wave.
Mel.phase: After learning Twisted Fate R Destiny, you can roam to create a numbers advantage in another lane. The scaling of Mel R Golden Eclipse builds up over time and makes the matchup harder, so slow Mel's growth from the early game.
Mel.teamfight: Deal damage with Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards from as far back as possible, and stop enemies diving onto your allies with Twisted Fate W Pick a Card's gold card. Save Q when Mel looks likely to activate Mel W Rebuttal, and hold your position away from the center of Mel E Solar Snare.
Mel.watch: Mel E Solar Snare roots you if it hits at the center and can be followed by Mel Q Radiant Volley, so dodge to the side. If you throw Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards while Mel W Rebuttal is active, it can be reflected back, so bait out W before using Q. If you've been hit by Mel's attacks several times, back off to avoid execution from Mel P Searing Brilliance. While stacks remain, also watch out for Mel R Golden Eclipse, which has no range limit.
