MissFortune.build: Buy Cloth Armor first to survive the early game. Miss Fortune's main damage is physical, so build armor first and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Armor does not block the magic damage from Miss Fortune E Make It Rain.
MissFortune.combo: Lock in a gold card with Twisted Fate W Pick a Card from a distance where you can reach Miss Fortune, then approach.
MissFortune.escape: Miss Fortune has no mobility spell, so look for a chance to close the distance with Twisted Fate R Destiny. If Miss Fortune E Make It Rain is active, wait outside the area before engaging. You can interrupt Miss Fortune R Bullet Time's channel with Twisted Fate W Pick a Card's gold card.
MissFortune.fight: Delay your engage in the area covered by Miss Fortune E Make It Rain.
MissFortune.laning: Don't stand directly behind a minion; move to the side to avoid the bounce from Miss Fortune Q Double Up. Move away right after Miss Fortune last-hits a minion to reduce her next basic attack poke. Clear the back line with Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards to push first, then roam or establish vision while you have time.
MissFortune.phase: Afterward, push the lane and build a numbers advantage elsewhere. In the late game, account for your fragility and add damage from the back.
MissFortune.teamfight: Don't start a fight where Miss Fortune E Make It Rain is active; draw her outside the area. Cast Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards from the back, then stop enemies diving onto your allies with Twisted Fate W Pick a Card's gold card. When Miss Fortune R Bullet Time starts, you can interrupt its channel with a gold card.
MissFortune.watch: Miss Fortune Q Double Up hits the first target, then bounces behind it, so don't stand in a line with minions. Miss Fortune E Make It Rain slows you, and you're in danger if Miss Fortune R Bullet Time overlaps it, so leave the area. When Bullet Time starts, interrupt it with Twisted Fate W Pick a Card's gold card or move out to the side of the cone.

Naafiri.build: Naafiri's main damage is physical, and Twisted Fate has low armor, so survive with Cloth Armor first. Choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. If your poke keeps getting erased by the healing from Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers and Naafiri E Eviscerate, slot in Morellonomicon after completing one core item.
Naafiri.combo: From a distance where you can reach with a basic attack, lock in a gold card with Twisted Fate W Pick a Card and approach. Stun with a basic attack, then follow with Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards and basic attacks. Use the locked-in card with a basic attack within 6 seconds.
Naafiri.escape: Don't engage just because either Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers or Naafiri E Eviscerate is down. In particular, look for a chance to close the distance with Twisted Fate R Destiny before Naafiri R Hounds' Pursuit comes back, then catch her with Twisted Fate W Pick a Card's gold card. If Naafiri W The Call of the Pack is active, use your gold card after it ends.
Naafiri.fight: Avoid direct fights early and poke from range with Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards. Right after Naafiri uses Naafiri E Eviscerate, clear the revived pack with Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards and counterattack. After Naafiri W The Call of the Pack ends, trade with a stun from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card's gold card.
Naafiri.laning: Farm from behind the minion line and don't give Naafiri an angle to close in with Naafiri E Eviscerate. Don't stand forward when you don't have Twisted Fate W Pick a Card's gold card. Angle Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards to clear the wave's back line, then use the time you bought by pushing first to roam or establish vision.
Naafiri.phase: After learning Twisted Fate R Destiny, push the lane and create a numbers advantage elsewhere. Watch for Naafiri's mid-game roams by establishing vision broadly. In the late game, fragile Twisted Fate should fight from the back and help the grouped team stop Naafiri's engage.
Naafiri.teamfight: Cast Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards from the back, then use Twisted Fate W Pick a Card's gold card on Naafiri when she dives onto your allies. Naafiri R Hounds' Pursuit locks onto a champion and dashes to them, so don't get isolated. Right after an ally dies, Naafiri can use Naafiri R Hounds' Pursuit again, so retreat immediately.
Naafiri.watch: If you're hit once by Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers and start bleeding, keep your distance until the bleed ends to avoid the second hit. Don't give Naafiri an angle to close in with Naafiri E Eviscerate, and don't travel alone when Naafiri R Hounds' Pursuit is available. Naafiri can't be targeted while Naafiri W The Call of the Pack is active, so use Twisted Fate W Pick a Card's gold card after it ends.

Neeko.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Neeko's main damage is magic, so build magic resistance first. If the likely sequence is getting rooted by Neeko E Tangle-Barbs, then dying to Neeko R Pop Blossom, prioritize tenacity.
Neeko.combo: In lane, lock in a gold card with Twisted Fate W Pick a Card, move into basic attack range, and use this sequence: stun basic attack → Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards → basic attack. The locked-in card disappears if you don't use it with a basic attack within 6 seconds. When roaming, activate Twisted Fate R Destiny for vision, lock in a gold card, then recast Twisted Fate R Destiny to move. Immediately upon landing, use a stun basic attack followed by Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards.
Neeko.escape: Right after Neeko E Tangle-Barbs is down is your chance to approach. Crowd control cancels Twisted Fate R Destiny's movement, so use it from out of sight when Neeko could interrupt it.
Neeko.fight: When Neeko E Tangle-Barbs is down, stun her with Twisted Fate W Pick a Card's gold card and trade briefly with Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards and basic attacks. Neeko has relatively low magic resistance, so Twisted Fate's main source of damage, magic damage, is effective.
Neeko.laning: Focus on pushing the wave before looking for a kill. Adjust the angle of Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards toward the side of the wave to clear the back line. While Neeko catches the pushed wave, roam or establish vision. If you hold Twisted Fate W Pick a Card's gold card too long, Neeko can create distance, so lock it in when she's in reach and use it immediately.
Neeko.phase: Even in the late game, Twisted Fate is fragile, so watch for Neeko's engage and deal damage from the back.
Neeko.teamfight: Cast Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards from the back, then stop Neeko with Twisted Fate W Pick a Card's gold card when she goes in on an ally. Spread out from your allies so Neeko E Tangle-Barbs can't root several of you. When you see the windup for Neeko R Pop Blossom, leave the area. When disguised Neeko gets close, spread out early instead of waiting for the windup.
Neeko.watch: Neeko E Tangle-Barbs grows and speeds up if it hits something first, making it easier to root people standing behind the first target, so don't stand on top of your allies. If Neeko approaches while disguised, you may not see the windup for Neeko R Pop Blossom, so back away as soon as a suspicious enemy gets close. Don't chase or attack the clone from Neeko W Shapesplitter; watch for the real Neeko's position.

Nilah.build: Nilah's main damage is physical, and Twisted Fate has low armor, so start with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Nilah Q Formless Blade has armor penetration, so don't rely on armor alone; build health too. If your poke keeps getting erased by healing, slot in Morellonomicon after completing one core item.
Nilah.combo: When Nilah W Jubilant Veil ends and you can hit her with a basic attack, lock in a gold card with Twisted Fate W Pick a Card and move into basic attack range.
Nilah.escape: Nilah E Slipstream has a short cooldown, so don't engage just because it's down; look for an angle to catch her with Twisted Fate W Pick a Card's stun. Your opportunity to use the gold card comes after Nilah engages and has spent Nilah W Jubilant Veil. When closing the distance with Twisted Fate R Destiny, start from outside enemy vision so effects like Nilah R Apotheosis can't interrupt your movement.
Nilah.fight: Poke with Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards before Nilah closes in, and don't stand forward when you don't have Twisted Fate W Pick a Card's gold card. After Nilah W Jubilant Veil ends, stun her with a gold card basic attack, then follow with Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards and basic attacks. Keep more distance while Nilah's range is increased after Nilah Q Formless Blade hits.
Nilah.laning: Instead of looking for a kill, push the wave first with Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards, then roam or establish vision. If Nilah is standing behind minions, angle Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards beside the wave.
Nilah.phase: After learning Twisted Fate R Destiny, push the lane and create a numbers advantage elsewhere. Even in the late game, you're fragile, so deal damage from the back and reposition as you fight.
Nilah.teamfight: Spread out from your allies so Nilah R Apotheosis can't catch several of you together, and cast Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards from the back. Once Nilah has engaged and spent Nilah W Jubilant Veil, stop her with Twisted Fate W Pick a Card's gold card. If Nilah R Apotheosis has already pulled you in, focus Nilah immediately so she can't finish the cast.
Nilah.watch: Right after Nilah Q Formless Blade hits, her attack range increases and she hits in a cone, so take another step back. Watch for Nilah E Slipstream to close the distance, and don't use Twisted Fate W Pick a Card with a basic attack while Nilah W Jubilant Veil is active. Spread out so Nilah R Apotheosis can't pull several of you in together.

Orianna.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game to withstand Orianna's magic damage. Choose Mercury's Treads for boots, and prioritize magic resistance when building resistances.
Orianna.combo: When fighting close up, lock in a gold card with Twisted Fate W Pick a Card and move into basic attack range. When roaming, activate Twisted Fate R Destiny for vision, lock in a gold card, then recast R to move and land basic attacks and Q as soon as you arrive.
Orianna.escape: Orianna has no spell to create distance on her own, so look for a chance to close the distance when Orianna W Command: Dissonance's slow and Orianna R Command: Shockwave's forced movement are down. The recast movement from Twisted Fate R Destiny is interrupted by crowd control, so activate it from outside enemy vision, then stun her with Twisted Fate W Pick a Card's gold card after landing.
Orianna.fight: Right after Orianna Q Command: Attack moves the ball away from her, she lacks the lasting defensive stats from Orianna E Command: Protect, so look to trade. However, don't take repeated basic attacks from Orianna P Clockwork Windup early; trade with spells instead. When you get a chance to close the distance, stun her with Twisted Fate W Pick a Card's gold card.
Orianna.laning: Focus on pushing the wave before looking for a kill. Angle Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards to clear the back line. While Orianna catches the pushed wave, establish vision or move to another lane. Use Twisted Fate W Pick a Card's blue card to restore mana, and don't stand around holding a gold card for too long.
Orianna.phase: Orianna is weak early, but Twisted Fate is also weak in direct fights, so focus on managing the wave. Even in the late game, Twisted Fate is fragile, so add damage from the back and keep moving.
Orianna.teamfight: Watch the ball's position rather than Orianna herself, and avoid spots where Orianna R Command: Shockwave can pull you in. Cast Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards from the back, then stop enemies diving onto your allies with Twisted Fate W Pick a Card's gold card.
Orianna.watch: Watch the position of the ball from Orianna Q Command: Attack and dodge accordingly. Near the ball, Orianna R Command: Shockwave can pull you in, and you should also watch out for the slow from Orianna W Command: Dissonance.

Qiyana.build: Buy Cloth Armor first in the early game and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Qiyana’s main damage is physical, and Twisted Fate has low armor, so prioritize armor.
Qiyana.combo: While Qiyana E Audacity is down, lock in the gold card with Twisted Fate W Pick a Card and move into basic attack range. If you approach with Twisted Fate R Destiny, reveal the area first, lock in the gold card, then recast R to travel.
Qiyana.escape: Don’t rush in when only Qiyana W Terrashape is down; Qiyana can still escape with Qiyana E Audacity. Your opening is right after she uses both mobility spells, especially before Qiyana E Audacity comes back up. Close the distance with Twisted Fate R Destiny and catch her with the gold card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card.
Qiyana.fight: Trade when Qiyana has used both Qiyana W Terrashape and Qiyana E Audacity and is still in front of you. Stun her with the gold card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card, then follow up with Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards and basic attacks.
Qiyana.laning: Avoid direct fights early, and don’t stand in front of Qiyana when you don’t have the gold card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card. Use Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards to clear the backline minions and push the wave first, then use that time to roam or get vision. When Qiyana Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal threatens a root, move out of range first.
Qiyana.phase: Qiyana is strongest in the mid game, so build armor and avoid giving her an advantage then. In the late game, group up, but stand away from walls so Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent can’t hit terrain at a good angle.
Qiyana.teamfight: Stay in the back and use Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards. When Qiyana jumps on an ally, interrupt her with the gold card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card. Hold an open position away from walls and terrain to avoid Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent.
Qiyana.watch: Qiyana Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal can root with the river element and stealth with the brush element, so watch which element she is holding and adjust your distance. Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent explodes and stuns when it hits terrain, so keep your back off walls and avoid encountering her in narrow river passages.

Ryze.build: Ryze’s main damage is magic, and Twisted Fate has low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. Get through the early game with Null-Magic Mantle, then buy Mercury’s Treads.
Ryze.combo: When you can get into basic attack range, lock in the gold card with Twisted Fate W Pick a Card, approach, stun with an empowered basic attack, then follow up with Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards and basic attacks.
Ryze.escape: While Ryze R Realm Warp is down, he can’t travel with his ultimate, so look for an opening to engage. If you dodge Ryze E Spell Flux, Ryze W Rune Prison only slows you; close the distance with Twisted Fate R Destiny and land the gold card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card.
Ryze.laning: Focus on pushing the wave before looking for kills. Angle Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards to clear the backline, then roam or get vision while Ryze catches the pushed-in wave. If Ryze E Spell Flux marks you, stay away from allies until it disappears.
Ryze.phase: Twisted Fate is still fragile in the late game, so deal damage from the back and look for chances to reposition.
Ryze.teamfight: Stay back and throw out Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards, then stop enemies diving onto your allies with the gold card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card.
Ryze.watch: If you’re hit by Ryze E Spell Flux, keep your distance from allies until the mark disappears. While marked, Ryze Q Overload is empowered and bounces to nearby targets, and Ryze W Rune Prison roots instead of slowing, so prioritize dodging Ryze E Spell Flux.

Samira.build: Samira’s main damage is physical, and Twisted Fate has relatively low armor, so build armor first. Get through the early game with Cloth Armor, then buy Plated Steelcaps.
Samira.combo: Lock in the gold card with Twisted Fate W Pick a Card and approach when you can reach basic attack range. Stun her with a basic attack, then follow up with Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards and basic attacks. If Samira W Blade Whirl is spinning, wait until it ends before using basic attacks and projectiles.
Samira.escape: Right after Samira E Wild Rush is down is your chance to close the distance and catch her. If you approach with Twisted Fate R Destiny, cast it outside the enemy’s vision and lock in the gold card with Twisted Fate W Pick a Card before traveling, so you can stun her as soon as you land.
Samira.fight: If Samira has used Samira E Wild Rush and no one has died, you have a chance to catch her. Wait for Samira W Blade Whirl to end, then stun her with the gold card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card and hit her with Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards.
Samira.laning: Manage the distance as Samira walks toward you. While you have time with the wave pushed, get vision or move to another lane.
Samira.phase: Twisted Fate is weak in direct fights early, so hold on while pushing the wave. He’s still fragile in the late game, so deal damage from the back and fight while repositioning.
Samira.teamfight: If Samira R Inferno Trigger starts, interrupt the remaining shots with a stun, but don’t use your empowered basic attack while Samira W Blade Whirl is spinning. When retreating, make sure low-health allies aren’t left behind, so Samira can’t chain in with Samira E Wild Rush.
Samira.watch: While Samira W Blade Whirl is spinning, it destroys projectiles and basic attacks, so use Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards and the empowered basic attack from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card after the spin ends. If Samira gets close and lands different types of attacks, she can use her ultimate, so create distance and limit the time she has to build up her style grade.

Senna.build: Get through the early game with Cloth Armor, then buy Plated Steelcaps. Senna’s main damage is physical, and Twisted Fate has relatively low armor, so build armor first. If Senna Q Piercing Darkness healing keeps undoing your poke, fit Morellonomicon in after completing one core item.
Senna.combo: Use Twisted Fate R Destiny to reveal the area, then lock in the gold card with Twisted Fate W Pick a Card.
Senna.escape: When Senna W Last Embrace misses or has been used, you have a chance to close the distance. Senna has no ability to create distance herself, so approach with Twisted Fate R Destiny and catch her with the gold card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card. Twisted Fate R Destiny’s travel is canceled by crowd control, so cast it from outside the enemy’s vision.
Senna.fight: When Senna steps forward to collect a soul, lock in the gold card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card within basic attack range, stun her, and hit her with Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards. If she hits you once, back off before she can attack again.
Senna.laning: Push the wave first with Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards, then roam or get vision. Keep track of where Senna’s souls are, and poke her when she steps forward to collect one to prevent her from collecting it. Dodge the straight path of Senna Q Piercing Darkness while angling Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards around the wave to hit Senna.
Senna.phase: Twisted Fate is weak in direct fights early, but Senna also has low health and attack damage early, so push the wave and disrupt her soul collection. Once you learn Twisted Fate R Destiny in the mid game, push the lane and move to other lanes to create a numbers advantage. In the late game, Senna’s range and attack damage grow as she collects souls, so fragile Twisted Fate should fight from the back.
Senna.teamfight: Deal damage from the back with Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards, and stop enemies diving onto your allies with the gold card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card. When Senna E Curse of the Black Mist appears, retreat to a spot with vision or throw Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards into the mist’s area to stop an engage. You can also use Twisted Fate R Destiny to reveal enemy positions to your allies even when you have no angle to travel.
Senna.watch: Senna Q Piercing Darkness passes through allies or minions and travels in a straight line, so move out of the line between Senna and her target. Dodge Senna W Last Embrace from behind minions; if it hits and marks you, move away from allies before the root. After Senna hits you once, back off so she can’t land a second attack and collect mist.

Seraphine.build: In the early game, buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Seraphine’s main damage is magic, and Twisted Fate has low magic resistance, so prioritize building magic resistance. If Seraphine W Surround Sound’s healing keeps undoing your poke, fit Morellonomicon in after completing one core item.
Seraphine.combo: For a standard trade, lock in the gold card with Twisted Fate W Pick a Card, approach into basic attack range, then use a stunning basic attack, Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards, and a basic attack in that order. If Seraphine E Beat Drop is down and you’re engaging with Twisted Fate R Destiny, reveal the area with R, lock in the gold card, then recast R. Land a stunning basic attack as soon as you arrive, then use Q.
Seraphine.escape: Right after dodging Seraphine E Beat Drop is your chance to engage. Seraphine has no mobility spell, so close the distance with Twisted Fate R Destiny and land the gold card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card. R’s travel is canceled by crowd control, so cast it from outside the enemy’s vision.
Seraphine.fight: Look to trade when Seraphine is alone and away from her allies. Right after dodging Seraphine E Beat Drop, close the distance with Twisted Fate R Destiny and stun her with the gold card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card. Lock in the gold card when you can get into basic attack range and use it immediately.
Seraphine.laning: In lane, focus on pushing the wave before looking for kills. Angle Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards beside the wave to clear the backline, then roam or get vision while Seraphine catches the pushed-in wave. Use the blue card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card to restore mana and the red card to clear the wave.
Seraphine.phase: After learning Twisted Fate R Destiny, push the lane and move to other lanes to create a numbers advantage. You’re still fragile in the late game, so deal damage from the back and move where needed.
Seraphine.teamfight: Deal damage from the farthest back with Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards, and stop enemies diving onto your allies with the gold card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card. Spread out to either side of your allies so Seraphine R Encore can’t extend by passing through them. Even when you have no angle to travel, you can use Twisted Fate R Destiny to gain vision and tell your allies the positions of the enemy jungler and mid laner.
Seraphine.watch: Seraphine E Beat Drop roots slowed targets and stuns targets who can’t move. If you’re slowed, get out of Seraphine’s line of attack. In team fights, spread out to either side of your allies because Seraphine R Encore’s charm travels farther each time it passes through an allied champion.

Sivir.build: Get through the early game with Cloth Armor, then buy Plated Steelcaps. Since Sivir Q Boomerang Blade and Sivir W Ricochet deal physical damage, build armor first. If Sivir E Spell Shield’s healing keeps undoing your poke, fit Morellonomicon in after completing one core item.
Sivir.combo: Draw out Sivir E Spell Shield first, then lock in the gold card with Twisted Fate W Pick a Card.
Sivir.escape: When Sivir E Spell Shield is down, you have a chance to engage. Sivir has no ability to create distance herself, so close the distance with Twisted Fate R Destiny and catch her with the gold card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card. Twisted Fate R Destiny’s travel is canceled by crowd control, so cast it from outside the enemy’s vision.
Sivir.fight: When Sivir E Spell Shield is available, fake an approach to bait it out. Once the shield is down, lock in the gold card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card and approach into basic attack range. Stun her, then follow up with Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards. Avoid long chases while Sivir R On The Hunt is active.
Sivir.laning: Focus on pushing the wave before looking for kills. Clear the backline with Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards, angling them around the wave to hit Sivir. Sivir clears waves quickly, so push the lane before roaming or make sure an ally is ready to catch it.
Sivir.phase: After learning Twisted Fate R Destiny, push the lane and move to other lanes to create a numbers advantage. You’re still fragile in the late game, so contribute damage from the back and look for chances to reposition.
Sivir.teamfight: Use Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards from the back and stop enemies diving onto your allies with the gold card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card. If Sivir E Spell Shield is down, look for a chance to approach with Twisted Fate R Destiny and catch her. While Sivir R On The Hunt is active, only take short fights using terrain and vision.
Sivir.watch: Watch the path of Sivir Q Boomerang Blade and dodge so it doesn’t hit you on the way out or back. Sivir E Spell Shield blocks one ability, so fake an approach to draw it out before using the gold card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card. When Sivir R On The Hunt is active, the entire enemy team moves faster, so avoid long chases.

Smolder.build: Smolder’s damage is mostly physical, and Twisted Fate has low armor, so start with Cloth Armor, build armor first, and get Plated Steelcaps. If Smolder R MMOOOMMMM!’s healing keeps undoing your poke, fit Morellonomicon in after completing one core item.
Smolder.combo: When Smolder E Flap, Flap, Flap is down, lock in the gold card with Twisted Fate W Pick a Card and approach into basic attack range.
Smolder.escape: Right after Smolder’s only escape, Smolder E Flap, Flap, Flap, is down, you have an opening to engage. Close the distance with Twisted Fate R Destiny and catch him with the gold card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card. If Smolder R MMOOOMMMM! is under Smolder’s feet, move out of the fire before going in again.
Smolder.fight: Make Smolder use Smolder E Flap, Flap, Flap, then stun him with the gold card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card and hit him with Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards. If you hold the gold card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card too long, Smolder will create distance, so lock it in when you can get into basic attack range.
Smolder.laning: Pressure Smolder’s farming early to slow his growth from Smolder P Dragon Practice. Dodge Smolder W Achooo! while using Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards to push the wave first, then get vision or roam. When targeting Smolder standing behind the wave, angle Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards around it.
Smolder.phase: In the mid game, after learning Twisted Fate R Destiny, push the lane and roam to build an advantage through objectives and turrets. Growth from Smolder P Dragon Practice is permanent, so time favors Smolder.
Smolder.teamfight: Twisted Fate should deal damage from the back with Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards and stop enemies diving onto allies with the gold card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card. Avoid the center of Smolder R MMOOOMMMM! and the fire under Smolder’s feet. You can use Twisted Fate R Destiny to reveal Smolder’s and the enemies’ positions to your allies even when you have no angle to travel.
Smolder.watch: Smolder W Achooo! explodes when it hits a champion, granting growth stacks and slowing them. Stand behind minions or move to the side to dodge it. Smolder R MMOOOMMMM! deals heavy damage at its center and heals Smolder, so move out of the fire before approaching again.

Sylas.build: Sylas’s main damage is magic, and Twisted Fate has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. Get through the early game with Null-Magic Mantle, then buy Mercury’s Treads. If Sylas W Kingslayer’s healing keeps undoing your poke, fit Morellonomicon in after completing one core item.
Sylas.combo: Lock in the gold card when you’re close enough to reach basic attack range, then approach. Hit him with the gold card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card to stun him, then follow up with Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards and basic attacks.
Sylas.escape: Don’t engage just because Sylas W Kingslayer is down. Look for an opening before Sylas E Abscond / Abduct comes back up: close the distance with Twisted Fate R Destiny and stun him with the gold card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card. If Sylas E Abscond / Abduct has already started, focus on dodging the chains that follow the first dash.
Sylas.fight: Poke Sylas with Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards before he gets close, and don’t stand in front of him while Twisted Fate W Pick a Card is unavailable. If Sylas engages with Sylas E Abscond / Abduct, interrupt him with a gold card stun and attack before he can heal with Sylas W Kingslayer. If only one of Sylas’s mobility spells is down, don’t rush in; he can escape with the other.
Sylas.laning: Use Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards to clear the backline, but angle them to poke Sylas if he’s standing behind minions. Push the lane first, then roam or get vision.
Sylas.phase: After learning Twisted Fate R Destiny, use the pushed lane to join other lanes and create a numbers advantage. Twisted Fate is still fragile in the late game, so attack from the back and fight while repositioning.
Sylas.teamfight: Twisted Fate deals damage from the back with Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards. If Sylas dives in with Sylas E Abscond / Abduct, stop him with the gold card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card and attack with your allies before he can heal with Sylas W Kingslayer.
Sylas.watch: Be more careful of the chains that follow Sylas E Abscond / Abduct than of its first dash. If the chains hit, they knock you up and you take a series of attacks, so time your dodge for the second action. If you’re clipped by Sylas Q Chain Lash, move away immediately to avoid the delayed explosion at the intersection.

Syndra.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Build magic resistance first against Syndra’s main damage, but also consider your total health so you can survive the true damage from Syndra W Force of Will and the execute from Syndra R Unleashed Power.
Syndra.combo: When you can get close, lock in the yellow card with Twisted Fate W Pick a Card and approach into basic attack range. When using Twisted Fate R Destiny to engage, reveal the area first, lock in the yellow card, then travel so you can immediately basic attack on arrival and follow with Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards.
Syndra.escape: Syndra has no mobility ability, and Syndra E Scatter the Weak is her only self-peel, so right after she uses it is your chance to engage. When using Twisted Fate R Destiny to close the gap, recast it from outside enemy vision so crowd control cannot cancel your travel.
Syndra.fight: Close the gap right after Syndra E Scatter the Weak is down, stun her with the yellow card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card, then follow with Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards. Lock in the yellow card when you can get into basic attack range and use it immediately. While Syndra E Scatter the Weak is ready, do not fight along a sphere’s line.
Syndra.laning: Your lane goal is to push the wave first rather than chase kills. Angle Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards diagonally past the wave to hit Syndra standing behind it, then roam or establish vision while the wave is pushed. Get boots early so you can walk around the areas targeted by Syndra Q Dark Sphere, Syndra W Force of Will, and Syndra E Scatter the Weak.
Syndra.phase: After learning Twisted Fate R Destiny, push the lane and create a numbers advantage in another lane. You are still fragile in the late game, so contribute damage from the back and keep moving. Reassess your spacing when Syndra’s ability effects change.
Syndra.teamfight: From the farthest back, throw out Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards and stop enemies diving your allies with the yellow card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card. Move away from areas where several Syndra Q Dark Spheres are down, since Syndra R Unleashed Power is dangerous there. Even without an angle to travel, you can use Twisted Fate R Destiny to check the enemy jungler and mid laner’s positions and alert your team.
Syndra.watch: If Syndra Q Dark Sphere lands between you and Syndra, Syndra E Scatter the Weak can stun you with the sphere it knocks back, so move off the sphere’s line. Avoid the slow and true damage from Syndra W Force of Will, and move away from areas where several spheres are down, watching out for Syndra R Unleashed Power.

Talon.build: Buy Cloth Armor first in the early game, and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Talon deals physical damage, so build armor first, and get health as well to help against his flat penetration. Twisted Fate’s magic damage is held back by Talon’s high magic resistance, so add penetration when you need to deal more damage.
Talon.combo: If you can approach after Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy is used, lock in the yellow card with Twisted Fate W Pick a Card and stun him with a basic attack. Follow with Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards and another basic attack. When joining a fight with Twisted Fate R Destiny, reveal the area, choose the yellow card, then travel so you can immediately basic attack on arrival and follow with Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards.
Talon.escape: The window to close the gap opens right after you make Talon use Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy. Approach with Twisted Fate R Destiny then and use the yellow card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card. It is even better to retaliate once you confirm Talon R Shadow Assault is also down.
Talon.fight: Poke from range with Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards, and be ready to use Twisted Fate W Pick a Card where Talon can reach you. Immediately after Talon uses Q Noxian Diplomacy, stun him with the yellow card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card to retaliate. Do not chase recklessly while Talon R Shadow Assault is available.
Talon.laning: Farm safely early and push the wave first so Talon does not reach level-ups before you. Angle Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards to hit the backline minions and Talon behind them. Push the lane to make Talon return to farm, and share his position with your team and establish vision along jungle paths when he disappears.
Talon.phase: After learning Twisted Fate R Destiny, push the lane and join another lane to create an advantage. Talon’s impact falls off late, but Twisted Fate is fragile too, so fight from the back.
Talon.teamfight: From the back, use Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards, then stop Talon with the yellow card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card if he reaches your backline. Fight grouped with your allies and layer crowd control on Talon. If Talon R Shadow Assault is ready, account for his stealth and do not chase recklessly.
Talon.watch: If you are hit by the outward cast of Talon W Rake, move out of the return path. Getting hit twice can stack Talon P Blade's End and lead to a bleed.

Tristana.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game. Since most of Tristana’s damage is magic and Twisted Fate has low magic resistance, build magic resistance first, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots.
Tristana.combo: While Tristana W Rocket Jump is down, lock in the yellow card with Twisted Fate W Pick a Card, approach into basic attack range, stun her, then follow with Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards and a basic attack. When roaming, use Twisted Fate R Destiny to reveal the area, lock in the yellow card, then recast R to travel. Stun her with a basic attack as soon as you land, then use Q.
Tristana.escape: The window to engage opens right after you make Tristana use Tristana W Rocket Jump. Close the gap with Twisted Fate R Destiny and catch her with the yellow card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card. Delay your engage if both Tristana W Rocket Jump and Tristana R Buster Shot are ready.
Tristana.fight: Close the gap after Tristana W Rocket Jump is down, when you can stun her with the yellow card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card.
Tristana.laning: Use Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards to clear the backline minions and push the wave toward Tristana’s turret. Tristana has trouble last-hitting there, so roam or establish vision while the lane is pushed. Keep your distance from allied minions to avoid the area damage from Tristana E Explosive Charge.
Tristana.phase: After learning Twisted Fate R Destiny in the mid game, push the lane and create a numbers advantage elsewhere. Tristana is difficult to deal with once her build is complete, so aim to end the game before then.
Tristana.teamfight: From the back, use Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards, then stop Tristana when she dives your allies with the yellow card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card. If an ally dies, Tristana W Rocket Jump resets and she can chain into another engage, so retreat immediately. Do not leave fragile allies in front as you fall back.
Tristana.watch: To avoid the area damage from Tristana E Explosive Charge, do not stand close to allied minions in lane. Do not engage carelessly while both Tristana W Rocket Jump and Tristana R Buster Shot are ready. Tristana R Buster Shot’s crowd control can cancel Twisted Fate R Destiny’s travel, so use it from outside enemy vision.

Twitch.build: Get a Control Ward first to prepare for Twitch Q Ambush’s camouflage. Twitch E Contaminate deals two types of damage, so building only one type of resistance blocks only part of it. Twitch P Deadly Venom’s true damage cannot be reduced by resistances, so consider your total health as well.
Twitch.combo: When you have an opening to engage, use Twisted Fate R Destiny to reveal the area, lock in the yellow card with Twisted Fate W Pick a Card, then recast Twisted Fate R Destiny to travel.
Twitch.escape: If Twitch W Venom Cask lands, leave the cloud first, then look for an engage. When Twitch Q Ambush’s camouflage ends, you can spot his position and get a chance to catch him with the yellow card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card. Crowd control cancels Twisted Fate R Destiny’s travel, so activate it from outside enemy vision.
Twitch.fight: Stun Twitch with the yellow card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card when he is revealed from camouflage or has activated Twitch R Spray and Pray and taken position. Twitch has no ability to create distance on his own, so you can close the gap with Twisted Fate R Destiny when you have an opening. End the trade and retreat before allowing several basic attacks to make Twitch E Contaminate’s finishing damage stronger.
Twitch.laning: If Twitch disappears from lane, assume he is moving behind another lane and alert your allies. Check brush where there is no vision and narrow paths with a Control Ward or go around them.
Twitch.phase: In the mid game, after learning Twisted Fate R Destiny, push the lane and create a numbers advantage elsewhere. You are still fragile late, so deal damage from the back while moving, and spread out to the sides to avoid Twitch R Spray and Pray’s piercing basic attacks.
Twitch.teamfight: From the very back, throw out Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards. If Twitch is revealed from camouflage or has activated Twitch R Spray and Pray and taken position, use the yellow card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card. Coordinate with your allies to attack the same target all at once. Spread out to the sides so you do not line up with allies in the direction Twitch R Spray and Pray is facing.
Twitch.watch: Twitch W Venom Cask both slows and applies Twitch P Deadly Venom stacks, so leave the cloud immediately if it lands under you. If you have been hit by several basic attacks, Twitch E Contaminate can kill you even when you have about half your health left, so judge when to retreat by how many times you have been hit rather than your remaining health. When Twitch R Spray and Pray is active, his range increases and his basic attacks pierce, so do not line up with your allies.

Varus.build: Use Cloth Armor to survive the early game, and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Build armor first against the physical damage from Varus Q Piercing Arrow and Varus E Hail of Arrows. Armor does not block the magic damage from Varus W Blighted Quiver and Varus R Chain of Corruption.
Varus.combo: At a range where you can reach Varus, lock in the yellow card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card and stun him with a basic attack, then follow with Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards and another basic attack. A locked-in card disappears if you do not use it with a basic attack within 6 seconds.
Varus.escape: Varus has no ability to create distance on his own, so the window to approach opens after you dodge or he uses Varus R Chain of Corruption. You can also close the gap while sidestepping Varus Q Piercing Arrow as he aims it. Crowd control cancels Twisted Fate R Destiny’s travel, so use it from outside enemy vision, then lock Varus down with the yellow card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card after landing.
Varus.fight: When you have Blight stacks, retreat beyond Varus’s ability range, then trade again. If you see Varus Q Piercing Arrow’s aiming animation, sidestep its path. Close in with the yellow card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card while Varus is slowed by his own ability.
Varus.laning: Early on, Twisted Fate should focus on pushing the wave first rather than taking direct fights. Angle Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards to clear the backline, then roam or establish vision while the lane is pushed. Use the blue card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card when you need sustain, and the red card to clear the wave.
Varus.phase: After learning Twisted Fate R Destiny, push the lane and move to another lane to create a numbers advantage. You are still fragile late, so attack from the back while moving. Briefly disengage right after Varus P Living Vengeance triggers on a kill or assist.
Varus.teamfight: Use Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards from the very back, and stop enemies diving your allies with the yellow card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card. Do not stand near allies rooted by Varus R Chain of Corruption; spread out to prevent the root from spreading. If an ally is killed and Varus P Living Vengeance triggers, keep your distance for those few seconds, then fight again.
Varus.watch: Varus W Blighted Quiver detonates Blight stacks applied by basic attacks when he hits with an ability, dealing damage based on your max health. If you have been hit by a few basic attacks, retreat before Varus Q Piercing Arrow or Varus E Hail of Arrows hits you, giving the stacks time to expire. Varus R Chain of Corruption can spread its root to nearby allies, so move away from an ally who has been hit.

Vayne.build: Use Cloth Armor to survive the early game, and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Build armor first against Vayne’s main physical damage and Twisted Fate’s low armor. However, armor does not reduce the true damage from Vayne W Silver Bolts, so do not keep taking hits.
Vayne.combo: After Vayne Q Tumble is down, lock in the yellow card with Twisted Fate W Pick a Card and, from basic attack range, use a basic attack to stun her → Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards → basic attack. You must use a locked-in card with a basic attack within 6 seconds, so choose it when she is within reach.
Vayne.escape: The window to engage opens right after Vayne uses Vayne Q Tumble. If Vayne E Condemn is also down, use Twisted Fate R Destiny from an area without enemy vision to close the gap, then catch her with the yellow card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card.
Vayne.fight: The window to close the gap opens right after you force Vayne to use Vayne Q Tumble. Stun her with the yellow card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card then, followed by Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards. Fight in an open area so Vayne E Condemn does not push you into a wall.
Vayne.laning: Early on, Twisted Fate is weak in direct fights, so focus on pushing the wave first rather than chasing kills. Angle Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards to clear the backline minions, then establish vision or roam while Vayne catches the pushed wave. Slow Vayne’s early growth, but do not pressure her when you have a wall behind you.
Vayne.phase: Both champions are weak early, but Twisted Fate should pressure Vayne’s farming by pushing the lane instead of taking direct fights. In the mid game, after learning Twisted Fate R Destiny, create a numbers advantage through roams and build on it with objective and turret gains. Late game, it is difficult to stop an itemized Vayne with defensive stats alone, so Twisted Fate should add damage from the back while moving.
Vayne.teamfight: From the very back, use Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards, then stop Vayne when she dives your allies with the yellow card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card. Fight in open areas rather than narrow passages so you can avoid the wall stun from Vayne E Condemn.
Vayne.watch: Do not fight with a wall behind you, since Vayne E Condemn stuns you if it knocks you into one. Vayne W Silver Bolts deals true damage based on your max health after hitting the same target a set number of times, so count the hits and leave her range before it triggers.

Veigar.build: Veigar’s main damage is magic and Twisted Fate’s magic resistance is low, so build magic resistance first. Buy a Null-Magic Mantle early, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots.
Veigar.combo: After Veigar E Event Horizon is down, lock in the yellow card with Twisted Fate W Pick a Card and approach into basic attack range.
Veigar.escape: The window to engage opens after Veigar uses Veigar E Event Horizon. Veigar has no mobility, so close the gap with Twisted Fate R Destiny and stun him with the yellow card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card. When traveling, activate Twisted Fate R Destiny from outside enemy vision so crowd control cannot cancel your travel.
Veigar.fight: Keep moving while dodging Veigar W Dark Matter instead of standing still to basic attack. When Veigar E Event Horizon is down, look for a chance to stun him with the yellow card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card.
Veigar.laning: Use Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards to clear the backline minions and push first, then establish vision or roam while Veigar catches the wave. Do not take pointless hits from Veigar Q Baleful Strike and give him scaling stacks.
Veigar.phase: In the mid game, after learning Twisted Fate R Destiny, push first and create a numbers advantage in another lane. Veigar gets stronger over time, so in the late game build magic resistance and check Veigar’s position and whether Veigar E Event Horizon has been used before moving.
Veigar.teamfight: Deal damage from the back with Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards. Stop enemies diving your allies with the yellow card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card, and check Veigar’s position and whether Veigar E Event Horizon has been used. When your health is low, get out of range of Veigar R Primordial Burst.
Veigar.watch: Stand behind minions against Veigar Q Baleful Strike, which helps Veigar scale when it hits and pierces only the first two units. Watch the ground marker and move to the side to dodge Veigar W Dark Matter. If caught in Veigar E Event Horizon, do not cross the edge; move inside and wait for it to disappear, or escape with Twisted Fate R Destiny. If your health is below half, move out of range of Veigar R Primordial Burst, which deals more damage based on your missing health.

Vex.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first early on and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Vex deals mostly magic damage, and Twisted Fate has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Vex.combo: As usual, lock in the Gold Card with Twisted Fate W Pick a Card, get within basic attack range, stun with a basic attack, then follow with Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards and basic attacks.
Vex.escape: The window to engage is when Vex P Doom 'n Gloom has been consumed on the wave or through poke, and Vex W Personal Space is also down. If the Gloom mark is applied after you move, get out of Vex's basic attack range and wait for it to disappear.
Vex.fight: When Vex P Doom 'n Gloom has been consumed and Vex W Personal Space's shield is down, stun her with the Gold Card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card, then follow with Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards and basic attacks.
Vex.laning: Use Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards to clear the backline minions and push first, then establish vision or roam in the meantime. If Vex stands behind minions, angle Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards past the side of the wave to poke her. Use the Blue Card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card when you need mana, and don't stand around holding the Gold Card for too long.
Vex.phase: Twisted Fate is weak in direct fights early, so push the lane instead of fighting Vex head-on. From mid game, when Twisted Fate learns Twisted Fate R Destiny, his strength is pushing the lane and creating a numbers advantage elsewhere. He is still fragile late game, so deal damage and keep moving from the backline.
Vex.teamfight: Twisted Fate uses Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards from the back, then stops Vex diving onto an ally with the Gold Card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card. If a low-health ally marked by Vex R Shadow Surge is killed, Vex's ultimate resets, so move that ally out of Vex's range before fighting. If Vex R Shadow Surge hits you directly, move toward your allies to create a chance to attack together when Vex dashes in.
Vex.watch: When Vex P Doom 'n Gloom is active, her basic abilities can fear you, so check whether Doom has been consumed before using Twisted Fate R Destiny to move near Vex. Vex E Looming Darkness covers a wider area the farther it travels, so if you are already within its range, dodge a short distance to the side. If Vex R Shadow Surge hits you and marks you, move toward your allies so you can take Vex's dash together.

Viktor.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first early on and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Viktor's main damage is magic, and Twisted Fate has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Viktor.combo: Lock in the Gold Card with Twisted Fate W Pick a Card, get within basic attack range, stun with a basic attack, then follow with Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards and a basic attack. When roaming, use Twisted Fate R Destiny to reveal the area, lock in the Gold Card, then move and immediately use a basic attack and Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards upon landing.
Viktor.escape: When Viktor W Gravity Field is placed, don't fight inside it; engage after leaving it. Once Viktor R Arcane Storm is down, there is less risk of your channel being interrupted, and you can close the gap with Twisted Fate R Destiny. Viktor has no dash, so if you get close, hold him with the Gold Card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card.
Viktor.fight: After leaving Viktor W Gravity Field, close the gap, stun him with the Gold Card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card, then follow with Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards. Account for the shield and movement speed from Viktor Q Siphon Power when deciding whether to trade.
Viktor.laning: Avoid Viktor E Hextech Ray's poke by not standing in line with the wave. Angle Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards to clear the backline minions, then roam or establish vision while you have pushed first. Take control early, before Viktor P Glorious Evolution stacks up.
Viktor.phase: In mid game, after learning Twisted Fate R Destiny, push the lane and create a numbers advantage elsewhere. Viktor becomes more difficult as he scales into the late game, so don't expect the same engage angles; fight from the backline.
Viktor.teamfight: Use Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards from the farthest back, then stop enemies diving onto allies with the Gold Card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card. Even if you get a chance to approach Viktor, don't stay inside Viktor W Gravity Field. You can use Twisted Fate R Destiny to reveal the area and tell your allies where Viktor and the enemy jungler are, even when you have no angle to move.
Viktor.watch: Viktor E Hextech Ray travels in a straight line, so don't stand in line with the wave; sidestep it. When Viktor W Gravity Field is placed, immediately walk out of its area and don't continue trading inside it. Viktor R Arcane Storm interrupts channels when it appears, so don't cast the teleport portion of Twisted Fate R Destiny within enemy vision.

Vladimir.build: Vladimir deals mostly magic damage, so buy a Null-Magic Mantle early and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. If his healing keeps undoing your poke, slot Morellonomicon in after completing one core item.
Vladimir.combo: Vladimir W Sanguine Pool interrupts projectiles and targeted abilities, so draw it out first with a low-cost ability. Once the pool ends, lock in the Gold Card with Twisted Fate W Pick a Card, get within basic attack range, then use stun basic attack → Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards → basic attack. You must use the locked-in card with a basic attack within 6 seconds.
Vladimir.escape: The window to engage is after Vladimir W Sanguine Pool is down.
Vladimir.fight: Early on, build an advantage by pressuring the wave rather than taking direct fights. After Vladimir W Sanguine Pool is down, close the gap, stun him with the Gold Card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card, then follow with Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards and basic attacks.
Vladimir.laning: When targeting a Vladimir standing behind the wave, angle Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards past the side of the wave. Use the time after pushing the lane to roam or establish vision.
Vladimir.phase: After learning Twisted Fate R Destiny, push the lane and create a numbers advantage in another lane. Vladimir becomes harder to deal with as the game goes on, and in the late game Twisted Fate should protect his fragile body, attack from the backline, and keep moving.
Vladimir.teamfight: Twisted Fate uses Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards from the back, then stops enemies diving onto allies with the Gold Card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card. Avoid grouping together so multiple allies are not hit by Vladimir R Hemoplague. If infected, fall back until the effect ends, then re-engage.
Vladimir.watch: Vladimir Q Transfusion restores health and, when empowered, also grants movement speed, so watch for your poke damage being erased. When Vladimir charges Vladimir E Tides of Blood, put minions between you and him or move out of range. If you are hit by Vladimir R Hemoplague, you take increased damage, so step back until the effect ends.

Xayah.build: Xayah’s main damage is physical and Twisted Fate has low armor, so build armor first. Use Cloth Armor to survive the early game, and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots.
Xayah.combo: Lock in the yellow card with Twisted Fate W Pick a Card, enter basic attack range, stun her with a basic attack, then follow with Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards and another basic attack.
Xayah.escape: Close the gap with Twisted Fate R Destiny then and use the yellow card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card, while staying out of Xayah E Bladecaller’s root path.
Xayah.fight: Do not fight in the same spot as Xayah for long. Make a short trade with the yellow card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card, then reposition. If Xayah R Featherstorm is down, you can close the gap with Twisted Fate R Destiny and engage again.
Xayah.laning: Early on, focus on pushing the wave first with Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards rather than taking direct fights. Reposition to avoid Xayah E Bladecaller’s return path, and roam or establish vision while the lane is pushed.
Xayah.phase: In the mid game, after learning Twisted Fate R Destiny, push the lane and build an advantage through roams. Twisted Fate is still fragile late, so add firepower from the back and look for opportunities to move.
Xayah.teamfight: Use Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards from the back, and stop enemies diving your allies with the yellow card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card. Before engaging Xayah, confirm Xayah R Featherstorm is down so she cannot negate your stun.
Xayah.watch: Xayah E Bladecaller roots you if you are hit by three or more returning feathers. If three or more feathers lie along the line between you and Xayah, move sideways immediately to get out of their return path.

Xerath.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first early on and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Xerath's main damage is magic, and Twisted Fate has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Xerath.combo: Lock in the Gold Card with Twisted Fate W Pick a Card and get within basic attack range, then use stun basic attack → Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards → basic attack.
Xerath.escape: Xerath has no mobility, so the window to engage is right after Xerath E Shocking Orb and Xerath W Eye of Destruction are down. Recast Twisted Fate R Destiny from a position outside enemy vision, then hold him with the Gold Card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card after landing.
Xerath.fight: Close the gap right after Xerath E Shocking Orb and Xerath W Eye of Destruction are down. When you can reach basic attack range, lock in the Gold Card with Twisted Fate W Pick a Card, stun him, then follow with Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards and basic attacks.
Xerath.laning: Early on, focus on farming and wave management rather than direct fights. Avoid Xerath's heavy damage and wait for him to run low on mana, then push the lane with Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards and call your jungler. Xerath Q Arcanopulse can hit you even behind minions, so move to the side when he charges it.
Xerath.phase: After learning Twisted Fate R Destiny, push the lane and move to another lane to create a numbers advantage. You are still fragile late game, so contribute damage from the backline and look for chances to move.
Xerath.teamfight: Hold your position while using Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards from the backline. Stop enemies diving onto allies with the Gold Card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card. Dodge when you see Xerath R Rite of the Arcane's cast animation, and look for a chance to approach Xerath, who cannot move while channeling, when you can engage.
Xerath.watch: Xerath Q Arcanopulse passes through minions, so when you see him charging it, change direction and dodge to the side. Be especially wary of Xerath E Shocking Orb, since its stun can leave you taking the full follow-up. Dodge immediately when you see Xerath R Rite of the Arcane's cast animation.

Yasuo.build: Buy Cloth Armor first early on and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Yasuo's main damage is physical, and Twisted Fate has low armor, so build armor first.
Yasuo.combo: When Yasuo W Wind Wall has disappeared or you have an angle to go around it, lock in the Gold Card with Twisted Fate W Pick a Card.
Yasuo.escape: Right after Yasuo throws the tornado from Yasuo Q Steel Tempest, he briefly has no way to knock you up, so look for an opportunity to engage. Yasuo E Sweeping Blade comes back quickly, so don't go in just because he has used it once.
Yasuo.fight: Use cheap poke to break Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer's shield before starting a trade. Right after Yasuo throws his tornado, stun him with the Gold Card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card, then follow with Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards and basic attacks. When you don't have the Gold Card, don't fight within range of Yasuo E Sweeping Blade.
Yasuo.laning: Avoid direct fights early and poke from a safe distance with Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards. Keeping a thin wave near your side of the lane reduces the minions Yasuo E Sweeping Blade can use as stepping stones, making it easier to deny his approach. When you can push the lane, angle Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards to clear the backline and use the time to roam or establish vision.
Yasuo.phase: After learning Twisted Fate R Destiny, push the lane and create a numbers advantage in other lanes. You are still fragile late game, so deal damage and keep moving from the backline.
Yasuo.teamfight: Use Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards from the backline, and stun Yasuo when he dives onto an ally with the Gold Card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card. While Yasuo W Wind Wall blocks projectiles, reposition for an angle or save your key abilities until the wall disappears.
Yasuo.watch: Yasuo E Sweeping Blade uses minions to approach, so don't stand in front among the minions. Yasuo Q Steel Tempest can knock you up with a tornado after two hits; if its stacks are full, leave its line and dodge to the side. When Yasuo W Wind Wall appears, reposition for an angle on Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards and your key card, or wait for the wall to disappear.

Yone.build: Prioritize movement speed so you can walk out of the range of Yone's telegraphed attacks. Yone deals both physical and magic damage, so don't focus on only one type of resistance. Yone W Spirit Cleave deals damage based on your maximum health, so avoid choices that only greatly increase your health.
Yone.combo: At a distance where you can reach Yone, lock in the Gold Card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card, stun him with a basic attack, then follow with Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards and a basic attack.
Yone.escape: Don't engage immediately just because either Yone Q Mortal Steel or Yone E Soul Unbound is down. If you use Twisted Fate R Destiny to close the gap during that window, start moving from a position outside enemy vision and lock Yone down with the Gold Card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card.
Yone.fight: When Yone has no tornado stacks on Yone Q Mortal Steel, keep your distance and poke with Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards. If Yone engages with Yone E Soul Unbound, use the Gold Card you saved from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card to stun him, creating an opportunity to prevent his return. When you don't have the Gold Card, don't fight Yone head-on.
Yone.laning: Back off when Yone Q Mortal Steel's tornado is ready, and don't stand forward without the Gold Card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card. Push the wave first with Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards, then roam or establish vision while Yone catches the wave.
Yone.phase: After learning Twisted Fate R Destiny, your ability to push the lane and create a numbers advantage in other lanes becomes stronger. Twisted Fate is still fragile late game, so contribute damage and keep moving from the backline.
Yone.teamfight: Twisted Fate deals damage with Q Wild Cards from the back, then stops Yone when he dives in with the Gold Card from W Pick a Card. Keep your distance from allies so Yone W Spirit Cleave can't hit several people and build a larger shield.
Yone.watch: Yone Q Mortal Steel dashes and knocks you up when its stacks are full, so while Yone repeatedly uses Q on minions, stay out of range and wait for the stacks to fall off.

Zed.build: Hold on early with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Zed's main damage is physical, and Twisted Fate has low armor, so build armor first.
Zed.combo: At a distance where you can reach basic attack range, lock in the Gold Card with Twisted Fate W Pick a Card, stun with a basic attack, then follow with Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards and a basic attack.
Zed.escape: The window opens after Zed W Living Shadow is down, but Zed can use Zed R Death Mark to escape if it is still available. In particular, before Zed R Death Mark comes back up, close the gap with Twisted Fate R Destiny and hold him with the Gold Card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card.
Zed.fight: Don't approach right after Zed W Living Shadow is used; look for an opening after the shadow disappears or Zed has already repositioned. Stun him by landing the Gold Card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card with a basic attack, then follow with damage from Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards.
Zed.laning: When you can't use the Gold Card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card, don't stand forward; push the lane, then roam or establish vision.
Zed.phase: Twisted Fate struggles in direct fights early, so don't give Zed an advantage and push the wave. After learning Twisted Fate R Destiny, push the lane and create a numbers advantage in other lanes; avoid getting caught alone during Zed's strong mid game. Zed falls off late game, and when your team groups, he has fewer isolated targets to pick off.
Zed.teamfight: Deal damage with Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards from the backline, and use the Gold Card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card on Zed when he dives onto an ally.
Zed.watch: Zed Q Razor Shuriken and Zed E Shadow Slash deal physical damage, and Zed E Shadow Slash from his shadow slows you. Watch the shadow's position and move outside its range; if Zed R Death Mark is on you, interrupt his follow-up with the Gold Card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card.

Zeri.build: Zeri Q Burst Fire and Zeri W Ultrashock Laser deal mostly physical damage, and Twisted Fate has low armor, so build armor first. Hold on early with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Zeri P Living Battery deals damage based on maximum health and has an execute, so don't rely on greatly increasing your health alone.
Zeri.combo: When Zeri E Spark Surge is down, lock in the Gold Card with Twisted Fate W Pick a Card and close in to basic attack range.
Zeri.escape: Zeri E Spark Surge is her only mobility tool, so engage right after she uses it. When closing the gap with Twisted Fate R Destiny, recast it outside enemy vision and prepare the Gold Card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card. If you push Zeri toward a wall, she can escape a long distance with E, so push her into open terrain.
Zeri.fight: The window to close the gap is right after you force Zeri to use Zeri E Spark Surge. If Zeri R Lightning Crash is active, don't chase; look for a chance to stun her with the Gold Card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card. Lock in the Gold Card when she is within basic attack range and use it immediately.
Zeri.laning: Zeri has short basic attack range and limited kill pressure before her core item, so build an advantage by poking from a safe distance. Use the time after pushing the lane to roam or establish vision.
Zeri.phase: Twisted Fate is fragile and has low damage early, so avoid direct fights while building an advantage before Zeri gets her core item. Twisted Fate remains fragile late game, and Zeri is hard to pick off because of her mobility, so fight from the backline.
Zeri.teamfight: Twisted Fate uses Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards from the back, then stops enemies diving onto allies with the Gold Card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card. Avoid walls and narrow passages to guard against the splash damage from Zeri W Ultrashock Laser.
Zeri.watch: Zeri W Ultrashock Laser spreads widely and deals more damage when it hits terrain, so don't stand with your back to a wall or face her in a narrow passage. After Zeri R Lightning Crash is activated, hitting enemies increases her movement speed, so don't chase her on foot. Watch out for the execute threshold on Zeri P Living Battery as well.

Ziggs.build: Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Most of Ziggs’s damage is magic, so build magic resistance first, and get the movement speed to leave the warning areas of his attacks.
Ziggs.combo: For a standard trade, lock in the yellow card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card when you can get within auto attack range, then use an auto attack to stun, Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards, and another auto attack.
Ziggs.escape: Ziggs has only one mobility tool: Ziggs W Satchel Charge, so the window to engage opens right after that tool becomes unavailable. Avoid paths covered by Ziggs E Hexplosive Minefield. When using Twisted Fate R Destiny to close the gap, start the recast from a spot outside enemy vision.
Ziggs.fight: Look to close the gap right after Ziggs W Satchel Charge is used to poke or clear the wave. Approach along a path without mines, stun him with the yellow card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card, then hit him with Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards.
Ziggs.laning: Don’t enter a path blocked by Ziggs E Hexplosive Minefield. Use the time after pushing the lane to roam or establish vision. If a turret has lost a lot of health, keep clearing that lane’s waves so Ziggs can’t take it down with Ziggs W Satchel Charge.
Ziggs.phase: Once you learn Twisted Fate R Destiny in the mid game, push the lane and create a numbers advantage in another lane. You’re still fragile in the late game, so deal damage from the backline and keep moving as you fight.
Ziggs.watch: Ziggs E Hexplosive Minefield slows you if you step on it, making you easier to hit with follow-up abilities. Detour around the mines or wait for them to disappear. When you see the warning area for Ziggs R Mega Inferno Bomb, move away from the center of the blast even if you can’t get completely clear.

Zoe.build: Early on, stay alive with Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Most of Zoe’s damage is magic, so build magic resistance first. However, Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble reduces resistance and also deals true damage, so dodging the bubble comes first.
Zoe.combo: For a standard trade, lock in the yellow card with Twisted Fate W Pick a Card, move into auto attack range, then use a stunning auto attack, Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards, and another auto attack. You must use the locked-in card with an auto attack within 6 seconds.
Zoe.escape: The moment Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble is down is an opportunity to engage with Twisted Fate R Destiny. Close the gap while Zoe R Portal Jump is down, too, and lock her down with the yellow card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card. Crowd control can cancel the R teleport, so activate it from a spot outside enemy vision.
Zoe.laning: Focus on pushing the wave before looking for kills. Angle Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards to clear the backline, then roam or establish vision while Zoe catches the pushed-in wave. Rather than holding the yellow card for too long, lock it in when you can get within auto attack range.
Zoe.phase: After learning Twisted Fate R Destiny, push the lane, create a numbers advantage in another lane, and build on your gains. You’re still fragile in the late game, so deal damage from the backline and keep moving as you fight.
Zoe.teamfight: Cast Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards from the far backline, and stop enemies diving onto your allies with the yellow card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card. If Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble is down, look for a chance to approach with Twisted Fate R Destiny. Before fighting over an objective, light up the area with a Control Ward and watch out for any remaining bubble traps.
Zoe.watch: If you’re hit by Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble, move behind a wall or an ally before the sleep triggers, and get out of the angle of Zoe Q Paddle Star! Even a bubble that misses leaves a trap, so watch narrow paths without vision and brush entrances. Zoe R Portal Jump always returns her to its starting point, so target that spot.
